Foster new business opportunities and user verticals
Innovate on shared risk methodologies

title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Risk
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and create new business models. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing some of the most important work of your career. You can read more about the business we’re building and what we’re looking forward to in our annual letter.

About the team

The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm.

Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.

At Stripe’s scale—$1.9T in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Staff Product Manager for Risk, you will lead cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives that fundamentally change how Stripe and our users manage risk. You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.

You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.

You will partner closely with Risk leadership to shape the organization’s strategy, vision, and most important investments. As a senior member of Stripe’s product community, you will also coach other PMs, raise the quality of product thinking across Risk, and advance the product management discipline across Stripe.

Responsibilities

• Identify high-leverage problems that cut across teams, turn ambiguity into clear product and technical direction, and establish measurable outcomes.

• Lead major cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives from initial shaping through delivery, adoption, and iteration.

• Lead changes to Risk’s approach to leveraging data and AI to accurately identify and mitigate risk at scale.

• Partner deeply with engineering, data science, and ML leaders to shape architecture, data foundations, models, APIs, and product experiences.

• Help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities quickly and effectively, while guiding Risk teams toward coherent, reusable infrastructure and product decisions.

• Partner with Risk leadership to define multi-year strategy, identify the organization’s most important bets, and make clear investment and sequencing decisions.

• Build alignment among teams with different goals and constraints, resolving difficult tradeoffs and driving progress without relying on formal authority.

• Coach and mentor PMs across Risk, helping them strengthen their product judgment, technical depth, strategic thinking, and execution.

• Advance the product management discipline across Stripe by raising the bar for how we define problems, develop strategy, partner with technical teams, and deliver complex cross-organizational work.

Who you are

We’re looking for an exceptional product leader who combines strong technical judgment with product insight, strategic range, and executional rigor. You identify important problems before they become obvious, bring clarity to deeply ambiguous spaces, and mobilize teams around solutions that work across products, organizations, and time horizons. You are deeply curious and stay at the forefront of advances in AI and technology, finding practical ways to apply them to our most challenging problems.

You move fluently from defining multi-year strategy to driving the details of execution. You build alignment and lead transformational work across teams without direct management authority. You earn trust through the clarity of your thinking, your focus on users, and your hands-on engagement in the work. You raise the ambition and effectiveness of the teams and PMs around you without needing to manage them.

Minimum requirements

• A track record of identifying and delivering high-impact, transformational product or technical initiatives that span multiple teams and organizations.

• Demonstrated ability to bring clarity to deeply ambiguous problems, set a compelling direction, and drive work through execution and adoption.

• Strong technical judgment across data, machine learning, AI, APIs, platforms, and system architecture.

• Experience partnering deeply with senior engineering, data science, and product leaders to shape both technical direction and product strategy.

• Strong product judgment across foundational infrastructure and user-facing experiences, with a focus on building capabilities that solve real user problems.

• Deep quantitative fluency and the ability to use data and causal reasoning to understand problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and measure outcomes.

• Proven ability to influence senior leaders, build alignment across organizational boundaries, and drive execution without direct management authority.

• Experience mentoring and developing PMs and raising the quality of product thinking and execution across teams.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to articulate compelling strategies, influence technical and executive audiences, and make complex topics clear.

title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Risk
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and create new business models. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing some of the most important work of your career. You can read more about the business we’re building and what we’re looking forward to in our annual letter.

About the team

The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm.

Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.

At Stripe’s scale—$1.9T in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Staff Product Manager for Risk, you will lead cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives that fundamentally change how Stripe and our users manage risk. You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.

You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.

You will partner closely with Risk leadership to shape the organization’s strategy, vision, and most important investments. As a senior member of Stripe’s product community, you will also coach other PMs, raise the quality of product thinking across Risk, and advance the product management discipline across Stripe.

Responsibilities

• Identify high-leverage problems that cut across teams, turn ambiguity into clear product and technical direction, and establish measurable outcomes.

• Lead major cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives from initial shaping through delivery, adoption, and iteration.

• Lead changes to Risk’s approach to leveraging data and AI to accurately identify and mitigate risk at scale.

• Partner deeply with engineering, data science, and ML leaders to shape architecture, data foundations, models, APIs, and product experiences.

• Help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities quickly and effectively, while guiding Risk teams toward coherent, reusable infrastructure and product decisions.

• Partner with Risk leadership to define multi-year strategy, identify the organization’s most important bets, and make clear investment and sequencing decisions.

• Build alignment among teams with different goals and constraints, resolving difficult tradeoffs and driving progress without relying on formal authority.

• Coach and mentor PMs across Risk, helping them strengthen their product judgment, technical depth, strategic thinking, and execution.

• Advance the product management discipline across Stripe by raising the bar for how we define problems, develop strategy, partner with technical teams, and deliver complex cross-organizational work.

Who you are

We’re looking for an exceptional product leader who combines strong technical judgment with product insight, strategic range, and executional rigor. You identify important problems before they become obvious, bring clarity to deeply ambiguous spaces, and mobilize teams around solutions that work across products, organizations, and time horizons. You are deeply curious and stay at the forefront of advances in AI and technology, finding practical ways to apply them to our most challenging problems.

You move fluently from defining multi-year strategy to driving the details of execution. You build alignment and lead transformational work across teams without direct management authority. • Strong technical judgment across data, machine learning, AI, APIs, platforms, and system architecture.

• Experience partnering deeply with senior engineering, data science, and product leaders to shape both technical direction and product strategy.

• Strong product judgment across foundational infrastructure and user-facing experiences, with a focus on building capabilities that solve real user problems.

• Deep quantitative fluency and the ability to use data and causal reasoning to understand problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and measure outcomes.

• Proven ability to influence senior leaders, build alignment across organizational boundaries, and drive execution without direct management authority.

• Experience mentoring and developing PMs and raising the quality of product thinking and execution across teams.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to articulate compelling strategies, influence technical and executive audiences, and make complex topics clear.

• High agency, intellectual honesty, curiosity, and a low-ego, hands-on working style.

Preferred qualifications

• An engineering and preferably ML-based technical background.

• Experience applying AI and machine learning to complex, high-stakes problems at scale.

• Experience with fraud, credit, payments, financial services, trust and safety, or another domain involving complex decisions and asymmetric consequences.

title: Staff Product Manager, Stripe Tax
description:
Stripe is building the economic infrastructure for the internet. Millions of businesses use Stripe to accept payments, manage revenue, and grow globally. Stripe Tax helps businesses calculate, collect, and manage indirect taxes as they sell across products, markets, and business models.

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to help shape the future of Stripe Tax. In this role, you will lead high-impact product strategy and execution across a broad portfolio, making it easier for businesses to understand, calculate, collect, and manage tax as they grow.

What you’ll do

As a Staff Product Manager on Stripe Tax, you will identify the most important opportunities to improve our tax products and turn them into focused strategies, durable platforms, and exceptional user experiences.

You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Tax, Partnerships, Go-to-Market, and other product teams to:

• Set strategy and lead product initiatives that help more businesses successfully adopt and use Stripe Tax.

• Improve the speed, accuracy, reliability, and usability of Stripe Tax calculations and related workflows.

• Expand support for the geographies, tax requirements, industries, products, and business models that matter most to Stripe users.

• Build capabilities for complex tax needs, such as registrations, exemptions, address and fulfillment logic, tax customization, and other business-specific requirements.

• Develop scalable products and platform capabilities that work across Stripe’s ecosystem, including integrations, connector apps, marketplaces, and Connect platforms.

• Partner across Stripe to create coherent end-to-end experiences spanning calculation, collection, reporting, and tax management.

• Use customer insight, market context, data, and technical understanding to prioritize investments and make clear tradeoffs.

• Align senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners around a shared product direction, measurable outcomes, and an execution plan.

What success looks like

You will help make Stripe Tax a product businesses can rely on as they scale. Merchants should be able to confidently answer “yes” to questions such as:

• Can I use Stripe Tax for my business and the locations where I sell?

• Does Stripe Tax support the taxes and business models that apply to me?

• Can it calculate tax accurately for my registrations, exemptions, customers, products, and fulfillment model?

• Is it fast, reliable, and easy for my team to operate?

• Does it work with the other Stripe products, platforms, and integrations my business depends on?

Who you are

You are a product leader who is comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-stakes spaces where customer needs, regulatory complexity, technical constraints, and commercial opportunity intersect. You can translate a broad mission into a focused strategy, build alignment across teams, and deliver meaningful products over multiple horizons.

You likely have:

• Significant product management experience, including ownership of complex, platform-oriented, or technically deep products.

• A track record of setting strategy and delivering multi-team initiatives with measurable business and customer impact.

• Strong judgment in prioritizing across customer needs, market opportunities, operational complexity, and engineering investment.

• Experience working closely with engineering and design partners to build reliable, scalable products.

• The ability to communicate clearly with executive stakeholders and to align diverse partners around a shared direction.

• Curiosity about global commerce, financial infrastructure, tax, compliance, payments, marketplaces, or developer platforms. Direct domain experience is helpful but not required.

• A customer-first mindset and the ability to turn complex requirements into simple, effective product experiences.

Why this role

Tax is a fundamental challenge for businesses that sell across borders, channels, and business models. Stripe Tax has the opportunity to remove that complexity, helping businesses launch faster, expand with confidence, and operate globally.

This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of global commerce, financial infrastructure, and product platform strategy. You will shape how Stripe Tax evolves to serve the next generation of internet businesses.

title: Sr. Performance Marketing Mgr, Veeqo
description:
We are seeking a Senior B2B Performance Marketing Manager with experience in marketing specifically for a B2B SaaS company targeting mid-market to enterprise level clients. The ideal candidate will be a data-driven and analytical marketer with a track record of driving growth through performance marketing, specifically across paid channels including search (Google, Microsoft), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), display, and programmatic. They have experience leading cross-functional paid media initiatives in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment, balancing long-term channel strategy with the ability to execute tactical optimizations in a fast-growing space. 

As the Senior B2B Performance Marketing Manager you will work closely with other members of the marketing team and cross-functional teams, to develop, test, and iterate on performance marketing campaigns that drive qualified leads and revenue growth. You will own, develop and scale paid media campaigns across the full funnel with the goal of driving acquisition, adoption and engagement with Veeqo. 

It is important the candidate can foster a creative team environment, inventing new approaches to ad creative and targeting, building robust A/B testing structures, diving deep into campaign performance data, and doubling down on what's performing. 

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Performance Marketing Manager you will: 

- Develop and execute comprehensive full-funnel paid media strategies across search, social, display, and programmatic channels that deliver measurable business results. 
- Manage the day-to-day operations of paid media campaigns including launching, testing, and optimizing ad creative, audiences, bidding strategies, and landing pages across the funnel. 
- Own budget allocation and pacing across paid channels, ensuring efficient spend and maximizing return on ad spend (ROAS) and cost per acquisition (CPA). 
- Lead marketing automation and audience strategy implementation to drive program efficiency and improve lead quality. 
- Establish rigorous testing frameworks (A/B, incrementality, geo-lift) and optimization processes. Develop metrics and measurement to determine campaign effectiveness and true incremental impact. 
- Lead budget planning and forecasting for paid media initiatives. You will be responsible for actively communicating the progress and financial health of the program across the organization. 
- Drive continuous innovation in measurement, attribution, and incrementality testing across paid channels. 
- Explore and scale emerging paid media opportunities including AI-powered ad formats, new platforms (e.g., Reddit), and audience expansion strategies. 
- Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Data to align on growth initiatives and ensure paid media supports broader business objectives. 
- Manage relationships with external agencies and platform partners to maximize campaign performance. 

About the team
Veeqo (veeqo.com) – a startup which was acquired by Amazon in 2021 – is Amazon's recommended shipping, inventory, and warehouse management solution for Sellers. Our vision is to become the multi-channel solution for eCommerce sellers, for both their on-Amazon and off-Amazon business. We help sellers manage fulfillment operations across all their online stores, and ship orders to customers at the lowest cost and in the fastest possible time. If you're interested in joining a rapidly growing team with a relentless focus on the customer, you've come to the right place. 

In order to accelerate the next phase of Veeqo's development, we are committed to transforming the depth, scale and ambition of our marketing capabilities. The marketing team uses data, seller insights, and automation to invent, test and scale programs that raise awareness of Veeqo and drive Sellers to signup or engage with our sales team. We're in a high-growth phase and seeking exceptional talent to drive our next stage of expansion.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience aggregating and analyzing internal and external campaign metrics to assess performance drivers and identify insights
- Proven track record of scaling paid media programs that delivered significant revenue impact, including measurement, creative strategy, audience targeting, and activation across all parts of the funnel.
- Deep hands-on experience managing campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and/or Meta Ads at scale.
- Strong understanding of paid media technology, bid management, attribution models, and marketing automation platforms.
- Ability to analyze raw campaign data and develop actionable insights related to paid media performance. Understanding of basic statistics and mathematical modeling concepts such as statistical significance, standard deviations, and regression analysis.
- Experience with incrementality testing, geo-lift studies, or other advanced measurement methodologies.

- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting

- Experience managing six-figure+ paid media budgets with demonstrated ability to optimize spend efficiency while scaling volume.
- Experience working with external agencies or platform reps to source creative and manage campaigns within a defined budget.
- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in SQL, Excel, and BI tools.
- Experience with AI-driven campaign strategies (Performance Max, broad match with smart bidding, etc.).
- Experience working with enterprise sales teams and understanding how paid media supports pipeline generation.
- International marketing experience, particularly running multi-market paid campaigns.

description:

- Establish and continuously improve repeatable processes for:
- Launch planning and execution
- Messaging and asset development
- Sales enablement
- Post-launch measurement
- Create clear frameworks, templates, and ways of working that enable the team to scale effectively
- Raise the bar on quality, consistency, and efficiency across all product marketing outputs

- Partner with Product and Lifecycle to ensure launches translate into real seller adoption and usage

title: Sr. GTM Lead, MeasurTwitch , Twitch Ads
description:
About Amazon Ads 

Amazon Ads is the digital advertising arm of Amazon and one of our fastest growing businesses. We operate at the intersection of commerce, entertainment and advertising. Amazon Ads offers unique advertising products, enterprise ad tech and a rich array of unique creative, format and measurement solutions. We believe that advertising, when done well, can connect the right brands with the right consumers while delivering holistic value. 

Twitch is the world's leading live-streaming platform, home to a highly engaged, hard-to-reach audience that spends billions of minutes each month watching gaming, entertainment, sports, music and creator-led content. As Twitch continues to scale its advertising proposition across EMEA, the ability to articulate the unique value of Twitch audiences to advertisers is a critical growth lever - and a capability we are building from the ground up. 

This is an individual contributor role embedded within the Twitch Go-to-Market (GTM) team who will focus on Insights and Measurement. You will work extensively with the Twitch sales specialists, GTM leads, product and ad-tech teams to develop and deliver insights that directly fuel revenue growth. 

This is not a backend role. You will actively participate in customer meetings as the subject matter expert on Twitch audience insights & measurement, and leverage Amazon's rich array of insights and measurement solutions - combined with Twitch-native data - to deliver media strategies that position Twitch as an essential part of the advertising mix.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the Twitch insights playbook from scratch: Develop a scalable library of Twitch audience insights, competitive benchmarks and measurement case studies that the sales team can deploy across pitches, QBRs and strategic conversations. 

- Equip the sales team to sell with confidence: Translate complex Twitch audience data (viewership, engagement, demographics, content affinities) into clear, compelling narratives that articulate the unique and incremental value of Twitch to advertisers. 

- Establish and advance senior-level relationships: Build relationships with senior marketing decision makers (e.g. Senior Director, C-level) by positioning yourself as the go-to expert on Twitch audience intelligence and at least one advanced analytical area of advertising. 

- Generate data-driven insights: Leverage Amazon's proprietary data, Twitch-native signals, third-party research and ad measurement solutions to generate actionable insights that prove the impact of advertising on Twitch. 

- Develop Twitch measurement expertise: Develop expertise in Twitch-specific metrics and Amazon's proprietary measurement tools, working to constantly evolve how we analyse and communicate the value of Twitch audiences to advertisers. 

- Directly support revenue growth: Partner with GTM and sales leadership to identify the highest-impact insight gaps, prioritise your roadmap accordingly, and measure your work against pipeline and revenue outcomes. 

- Advocate for data-driven decision-making: Guide advertisers to implement recommended solutions, with a particular focus on demonstrating Twitch's role in full-funnel and cross-platform strategies. 

- Influence product and go-to-market strategy: Write internal documents with strategic recommendations that influence the direction of Twitch advertising products, measurement capabilities and go-to-market working mechanisms with internal stakeholders. 

- Scale your analyses: Actively scale your analyses to other categories or locales through AI-native solutions. 

A day in the life
No two days at Amazon are the same. You will have the flexibility to work with your stakeholders and define a book of business that will maximise your impact on Twitch revenue. On any given day, you might find yourself: 
- Building a bespoke audience profile to help a seller win a competitive brief in colaboration with our Audience&Insights organization
- Presenting Twitch viewership insights at a sales-led event or advertiser summit 
- Partnering with the GTM team to shape the narrative for a tentpole moment like TwitchCon 
- Running an intricate analysis to influence a key advertiser decision 
- Working with the product/engineering team to pilot a new measurement solution tailored to live-streaming environments 
- Collaborating with the A&I team to bring methodological rigour to a Twitch-specific research project 

About the team
Twitch GTM team - a small, high-impact squad responsible for equipping Twitch-dedicated sellers across EU5 with the strategies, tools and narratives they need to hit ambitious growth targets. You will also work closely with the Analytics & Insights (A&I) team within Amazon Ads, a sales enablement group responsible for developing actionable and innovative insights that prove the value of Amazon Ads to advertisers and partners. 

Your unique position bridging both teams means you will bring the rigour and methodology of A&I together with the commercial urgency and customer proximity of GTM - a combination that is essential to closing the insights gap and unlocking Twitch's revenue potential.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking
- Experience in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

title: Sr. GTM Lead, Twitch Ads, Amazon Ads
description:

We operate at the intersection of commerce, entertainment and advertising, offering unique advertising products (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display), enterprise ad tech (Amazon DSP, Amazon Ad Server, Amazon Marketing Cloud, Amazon Publisher Services) and a rich array of unique creative, format and measurement solutions. We offer advertisers premium brand placements on our owned and operated properties, including Thursday Night Football, FreeVee, Prime Video, Twitch, and FireTV as well as on third-party publishers via Amazon Publisher Services.

We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including in advertising. We believe that advertising, when done well, enhances the customer experience with delightful discovery for consumers and compelling performance for advertisers. The insights we deliver to advertisers and their partners enable them to build unique connection with consumers, from first discovery to loyalty in a unique and compelling way versus any other media platform at scale.

We seek a seasoned professional to join us as Sr. GTM Lead, Twitch Ads UK & EU5. title: Sr Product Manager, Tax Engine
description:
Amazon’s Tax Services organization is building the next generation of solutions to shape the way that we calculate, collect and invoice tax information as one of the world’s largest collectors of online indirect taxes and fees. Our organization’s mission is to ensure that Amazon has the right technology and processes to remain accurate and adaptable in a rapidly changing business and tax environment.

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a Sr Product Manager to join us in London and help build the future of the Tax Services document printing product, which is responsible for generating billions of business-critical documents (e.g. tax invoices, commercial and transport documents) every year. As a Sr Product Manager, you will be responsible for identifying and executing on opportunities to build high-impact solutions and features for our document printing product that meet customer needs and drive business growth.

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial product manager who is passionate about solving complex and ambiguous problems, and who thrives in a fast-paced environment. This position has a high level of visibility, so you will need to be able to communicate clearly and compellingly at all levels of the company. Additionally, you will be responsible for measuring business impact by diving deep into metrics, tying inputs to business outcomes, and working backwards from customers. You should have a positive attitude and strong work ethic; you will work fast and smart, and adapt and iterate quickly. This role operates in highly ambiguous areas – ideal candidates have a proven track record of bringing clarity, simplifying and prototyping to iterate fast.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:

- Understand and explain the impact of product features on the strategic value, useability and performance of the document printing product.
- Make prioritization and trade-off decisions among customer experience, scope, and time to market.
- Manage product planning and feature prioritization through day-to-day collaboration and decision making with a cross-functional team including engineers, designers, and business development partner teams.
- Develop detailed, crisp user stories with acceptance criteria based on customer needs/experience and business requirements that can be used to create product specifications and architecture.
- Define and analyze metrics that measure and benchmark product success.

A day in the life
As a Sr Product Manager in Tax Services, your day will be a mix of meetings and heads-down time for strategy and roadmap planning, and tactical execution. You’ll meet with customers and peers across product, engineering, UX, tax and legal to understand their needs and identify features for our document printing product. You’ll develop functional product and user experience requirements for new features and processes to help meet our customer needs. You will be expected to own the end-to-end roadmap for discrete product features from requirements gathering through to implementation, working across teams to break down silos and drive feature delivery on the product. The work you deliver has a direct impact on the future portfolio of products for the Tax Services organization.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products
- Experience with product cycles of 6+ months
- Experience in product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

description:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

We are looking for a talented Senior Performance Marketing Manager to lead Programmatic media channels for our EMEA B2C business. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.”

• Lead the strategy, design, and execution of programmatic media campaigns across DSPs (Amazon DSP, DV360) for Amazon Leo’s B2C business across all EMEA markets, optimizing for Gross Ads, CPA/ROAS targets.
• Own the end-to-end relationships with internal ADSP teams and agencies for the programmatic channel including briefing, campaign planning, execution oversight, performance governance, and optimization.

- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements

We own localization readiness for Amazon's international expansion, working across multiple business lines to plan, scope, and deliver localized content that customers, sellers, and partners trust on Day 1. We sit at the intersection of language, technology, and global strategy. We're a strategic partner that shapes what gets built, when it launches, and how it scales. title: Category Manager Power & Utilities, Global Procurement Organization (GPO)
description:
We are the Global Procurement Organization, and we're on a mission to reshape how one of the world's largest companies powers its operations with clean energy. We're looking for a Category Manager to lead and develop our on-site solar energy portfolio across Europe, the UK, and the Middle East, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver hundreds of megawatts of new capacity and tens of millions in cost savings.

You'll be building the playbook for solar procurement in some of the fastest-growing renewable energy markets on the planet:

Manage the full solar portfolio across diverse markets from Western Europe to the Arabian Peninsula, collaborating with regional stakeholders in markets where solar capacity is projected to grow 10x by 2035

Navigate complex regulatory landscapes—from EU clean energy mandates to Saudi Vision 2030 and the UAE's ambitious renewable targets

Structure creative deals, deciding when to deploy capital purchases vs. power purchase agreements vs. operating lease models across markets with very different economics

Contribute to meaningful sustainability impact—your work will directly eliminate thousands of metric tons of CO2 annually while reducing grid dependency across hundreds of logistics facilities, supporting Amazon's climate commitments

Help build a category from the ground up in emerging Middle East markets, working with local teams where solar is unlocking operations in locations where traditional grid connections aren't even possible

If you enjoy solving complex problems across cultures and borders, and want your work to have measurable environmental and financial impact, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute the long-term sourcing strategy for on-site solar across Europe, UK, and Middle East, covering rooftop, carport, and ground-mount technologies, in partnership with engineering and sustainability teams
- Lead portfolio-based tenders, bundling demand across multiple countries to maximise negotiation leverage and reduce procurement cycle times
- Build financial models—including net present value, total cost of ownership, and payback analysis—to support investment decisions and senior leadership recommendations
- Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships through quarterly business reviews, performance tracking, and capacity planning while maintaining competitive tension across the vendor base
- Identify and mitigate supply chain risks including equipment lead times, trade policy shifts, and regional market constraints
- Track energy production performance against forecasts and collaborate with technical teams to drive continuous improvement in system output and cost efficiency
- Lead category consolidation efforts, bringing fragmented solar activities under a unified procurement framework to unlock savings and standardise specifications

A day in the life
Your day starts with a portfolio review call across European markets, then shifts to negotiating contract terms with a supplier for a compliance-driven deployment. After lunch, you're deep in a financial model stress-testing deal structures for a new Middle East opportunity. By afternoon, you're syncing with engineering, legal, finance, sustainability, and construction partners to keep projects on track. The variety is constant—and no two days look the same as you move between strategy, negotiation, and execution across time zones.

About the team
You'll join the Power and Utilities team within Amazon's Global Procurement Organization. We manage the full energy lifecycle for Amazon's worldwide operations across five areas: utilities supply and audits, power infrastructure and grid services, on-site renewables and storage, EV charging infrastructure, and hydrogen mobility solutions. This role sits within the renewables and storage pillar, but you'll work alongside colleagues tackling everything from microgrids and demand response to hydrogen refuelling and electric vehicle charging. We're a global team that is scaling fast and rewriting how large-scale operations source, generate, and consume power.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management

description:

Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated customer experiences; every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role sits at the centre of it. You will drive the migration of on-premises SQL Server and Oracle estates to AWS managed databases, position AWS's purpose-built database portfolio, and ensure our customers' data foundations are cloud-native, resilient, and AI-ready. You will work on some of EMEAs largest customers and largest deals, partnering closely with our migrations and account teams and partners to land complex, multi-year outcomes. You will be involved in the full life cycle of construction projects while working with motivated experts from design, construction, procurement, finance and legal teams to deliver efficient and innovative data centers.

title: Senior Category Manager, Construction, Global Procurement Organization (GPO)
description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. We are seeking a Senior Category Manager to lead the commercial delivery of complex, multi-disciplinary, multi-million-dollar Ops construction projects across one of our global regions.

 The Construction Category team owns the end-to-end sourcing strategy for general contractors, developers, and key trade packages. This role will work alongside a team of Construction Category Managers and partner closely with Pre-Construction, Design & Construction, Real Estate, and World Wide Design to develop and execute category sourcing strategies, maximize managed spend, deliver measurable net cost savings, and drive competition into historically under-competed markets.

 The team operates at the intersection of Amazon's Climate Pledge commitments and unprecedented construction demand, including responsibility for sustainable construction materials such as steel, low-carbon steel, and low-carbon concrete. You will collaborate cross-business with AWS to leverage Amazon's combined construction scale and avoid market fragmentation.

 This is a high-growth, fast-moving team undergoing significant global expansion. The right candidate is a self-starter with dedication to seeing projects through to the end, able to work independently in a collaborative, creative, and ambiguous environment. You bring an eye for detail, determination to standardize processes, and the ability to deliver high-quality work. This position involves direct engagement with internal and external stakeholders at every level - from project teams to senior leadership - and requires the credibility to inform decision-making and earn trust across the business.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end commercial delivery of multi-million-dollar GC construction projects; sourcing, competitive bid, award, contract execution, and handover.
- Develop and execute sourcing strategies that drive competition, maximize managed spend, and deliver measurable net cost savings.
- Partner cross-functionally with Real Estate, Design & Construction, and Engineering Services to align vendor capacity with program milestones including Prime week and Peak readiness.
- Run the full supplier lifecycle: performance management, should-cost analysis, concentration risk monitoring, and sustainability delivery aligned with Amazon's Climate Pledge.
- Earn trust with senior stakeholders by providing data-driven market intelligence; GC capacity, regional pricing trends, and strategic opportunities — to inform roadmap decisions.
- Define and own KPIs (cost, speed, quality, risk); track team progress against targets and drive continuous process improvement.

A day in the life
You negotiate with GCs and subcontractors in the morning, build a should-cost model over lunch, and present a sourcing recommendation to leadership by end of day, no two days look the same.
 You sit at the crossroads of Design & Construction, Real Estate, Engineering Services, and Finance, translating program needs into commercial outcomes that deliver sites on time, on budget, and aligned with Amazon's Climate Pledge.
 You flex between strategy and execution: developing a regional vendor panel one week, resolving a contractor escalation the next.
 You deep-dive data; market pricing, GC capacity, spend concentration to surface opportunities others miss and bring them to life at Amazon scale.

About the team
The Construction Category team is building something new. We manage one of Amazon's largest and fastest-growing global spend categories across NA, EMEA, LATAM, MEATR, and APAC - driving competition, cost transparency, and sustainability into how Amazon builds. The team is growing, standing up regional vendor panels, deploying should-cost capabilities, and delivering on Amazon's Climate Pledge through sustainable materials sourcing including steel, low-carbon steel, and low-carbon concrete. If you want to shape procurement's role in how Amazon builds - not just support it - this is where to be.

- Experience in strategic sourcing and category management in indirect categories such as professional services, support or maintenance spend, supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience
- Experience in negotiations/cost savings, supplier excellence, and risk mitigation experience
- Experience in construction management or working with general contractors and managing supplier diversity initiatives experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements

title: Specialist II, Brand Marketing, Football, France
description:
Are you ready to help shape the future of Nike Football in France? As Specialist II, Brand Marketing, Football, France, you will help bring Nike's football strategy to life across the country, with a particular focus on Paris, Lyon and Marseille.
 
Working closely with the Manager, Brand Marketing, Football, France, you will turn seasonal priorities into distinctive, locally relevant consumer experiences. You will lead selected integrated campaigns and tactical initiatives across product, athletes, partnerships, retail and football culture, from planning and delivery to evaluation.
 
You will connect Nike's Global and EMEA football vision with a strong understanding of consumers in France. Your work will reflect and support the diverse communities shaping the game, on and off the pitch.
 
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
This role reports to the Manager, Brand Marketing, Football, France, and works closely with the broader France Brand Marketing team.
 
Internally, this person partners with Sports Marketing, Brand Creative, Communications, Energy Marketing, Retail Marketing, Nike Sport Marketplace, Consumer Insights, Social & Community Impact, Digital Marketing, and Marketing Operations & Planning. The role also maintains a strong connection with the EMEA Football Brand Marketing team.
 
Externally, this person builds effective working relationships with creative and activation agencies, athletes, key partners such as FFF and PSG, creators, football communities and strategic retail partners.
 
WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
The ideal candidate is a brand marketer who understands football in France, its diverse communities and the role Nike can play within the game.
 
This person understands football beyond the 90 minutes, including how the game connects with youth culture, style, music, creativity, community and the marketplace. They can turn consumer and cultural insights into clear marketing opportunities, compelling stories and meaningful experiences.
 
The ideal candidate can move between strategic thinking and hands-on delivery. They can support complex projects, align cross-functional teams and agencies, make informed recommendations, and involve the Manager or wider leadership team when needed. They communicate clearly, anticipate challenges, work effectively through ambiguity and build trust with a wide range of stakeholders.

The successful candidate will bring:

• Relevant experience in brand marketing or integrated consumer marketing. Experience in football, sport, lifestyle, fashion, entertainment or culture is valuable but not essential.

• Strong knowledge of football consumers, the marketplace and the cultural landscape in France.

• Experience leading integrated campaigns or activations across multiple consumer touchpoints.

• Experience working with one or more of the following: athletes, clubs, federations, creators, communities or retail partners.

• The ability to connect strategic thinking with practical delivery.

• Strong written, verbal and presentation skills in French and English.

• A proactive, adaptable and solution-focused approach, with the ability to work independently and collaborate in a fast-moving environment.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
Activate Nike Football’s Portfolio

• Support the Manager in turning Nike's athlete, club and federation portfolio into meaningful brand opportunities.

• Partner with Sports Marketing to identify stories and moments that connect Nike Football with consumers.

Drive Product and Marketplace Impact

• Partner with Retail Marketing teams to create distinctive experiences across Nike Direct and strategic retail partners.

• Bring brand storytelling, athletes, communities and retail execution together into clear, connected consumer journeys.

Stay Close to Football Culture and Consumers

• Identify emerging consumer behaviours, communities, creators and cultural shifts shaping football in France.

• Partner with local communities and teams to turn insights into practical brand opportunities.

• Identify where Nike can credibly lead and shape football culture, on and off the pitch.

• undefined

Be a Trusted Partner to the Football Brand Manager

• Support the Manager with seasonal planning, prioritisation, leadership updates and cross-functional alignment.

• Take ownership of defined workstreams and keep the Manager informed at key decision points.

title: Manager, Brand Marketing, Running, UK & Ireland
description:
WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR 
Inspire movement. Elevate athletes. Shape the future of Running in one of the world’s most influential sport cities. As Running Brand Manager, you will drive the strategy and execution that brings Nike Running to life across the UK & Ireland, with London as the epicentre.

You’ll shape the future of Running by connecting deeply with athletes*, creators, communities, and cultural leaders — translating global direction into locally resonant stories, experiences, activations and partnerships that move the next generation.

We are looking for an experienced and talented brand marketeer with a passion for Running & sport, a curiosity for our young consumer, and an ability to uncover stories that will inspire movement. A marketeer experienced in brand management and cross-functional marketing (including digital & retail marketing), keen to create a culture of high performance and inspiration to reimagine the future of sport and make athletes’ dreams real. A talent who thrives on creativity and innovation, turning insights into ideas and ideas into storytelling and experiences that resonate. Driven by consumer obsession, with a growth mindset, you’re willing to adapt on the fly to deliver awe inspiring marketing plans. 

WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON 
You will drive the brand offense for Nike Running across the UK & Ireland, ensuring cultural relevance, athlete* obsession, and business impact. 

• Drive the Nike Running Brand Strategic Plan on the ground for UKI&I. 

Translate global and EMEA direction into sharp, insight‑led, London‑rooted strategies. Build integrated seasonal and daily plans that elevate brand strength and drive consumer engagement.Ensure London’s PoV shapes EMEA and Global strategy.

• Drive Cross‑Functional Execution Across London & UK&I.

 Lead end‑to‑end execution of Running campaigns & initiatives, including London specific moments, working closely with retail and partner marketing. Ensure global and EMEA Concept Map moments land powerfully on the ground through activations, community experiences and marketplace executions. 

• Create and sustain London’s Nike Running Ecosystem. 

Identify and nurture relationships with the people & organisations that embody our brand values and bring our strategy to life, then manage these relationships in a robust & sustainable fashion. Obsess the Running marketplace in London and across the UKI — understand where the consumer is moving, why and how Nike running can best serve them.

• Fuel Nike with Sharp Consumer Insight 

Through keeping Nike’s ear to the ground. Gather structured, continuous learnings from athletes* and communities to allow us to better serve them on the ground and to feed insights back to EMEA/Global to refine longer term strategy. Identify cultural opportunities, emerging trends, and tension points that shape future strategy.

• Lead Project Management, People Leadership & Operational Excellence. 

Manage timelines, budgets, and cross‑functional alignment to deliver work at a pinnacle level. Build & lead cross-functional teams to deliver true high performance, through diverse thinking & skillsets. Develop and empower one direct report fostering a performance and growth‑minded culture. 

WHO WILL YOU WORK WITH 
Reporting to the Brand Director, Running, Training & Brand Initiatives, UK & Ireland, you will sit within the UK & Ireland Brand Marketing Team. You will work collaboratively with UK&I and EMEA partners across Brand, Creative, Sports Marketing, Integrated Retail Marketing, Energy Marketing, Marketplace, Communications and SCI — as well as the communities, individuals and organisations helping shape running culture across London and the UKI.
While focused on Running, you'll have opportunities to contribute to broader UK & Ireland marketing priorities as business needs evolve.

WHAT YOU BRING TO NIKE
A culturally tuned‑in brand leader with a deep understanding of London’s Running scene and a passion for sport, running and community. Someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution — equally comfortable shaping a narrative, building disruptive ideas, leading a team, or being on the ground with athletes*.
You bring: 

• Proven experience in brand management or consumer marketing, with a strong focus on cross- functional marketing.

• A genuine passion for Running with a deep understanding of the London Running landscape, consumer, communities and Nike’s position within.

• A strong track record in partnership management with experience identifying, owning and managing external relationships with individuals and organisations.

• Experience building consumer-led brand strategy from insight through to execution.

• Proven ability to develop and deliver impactful marketing ideas and initiatives through cross-functional team leadership.

• High‑level communication skills and the ability to influence across the organisation.

• Agility, resilience, and a growth mindset — thriving in dynamic environments and elevating the work at every turn.

• Strong leadership and people development skills, with previous people management experience. 

Applications will be accepted until 3rd of December. We encourage external candidates to apply as soon as possible, as the posting may close earlier if we receive a sufficient number of applications.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

The Opportunity

Adyen is a full-stack payment processor and licensed global bank, serving millions of businesses and billions of shoppers. As we grow into banking, card issuing, and embedded finance, the stakes of who we let into our platform, and what they do once they’re here, keep rising.

Fraud Intelligence protects Adyen from two kinds of bad actors: those who disguise who they are to gain access to the financial system, and those who set out to cause financial loss for Adyen or our customers.

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead a senior team of product managers across Identity Fraud & KYC, Commercial Risk, and Platform Fraud. You’ll work hand in hand with our global Compliance and Operations teams to build a data-driven defense, from onboarding through every transaction. This is not a standard product role. We need a biztech leader with strong technical instincts who runs the domain like a high-growth business.

What You’ll Do

• Set the Vision: Own the strategy for how Adyen detects and stops identity fraud and platform fraud. Treat these capabilities like your own business, balancing customer value, revenue, and cost.

• Lead & Develop Senior Talent: Coach and grow a team of senior product managers who own their domains end to end.

• Partner Globally: Work closely with global Compliance and Operations teams to turn regulatory obligations into automated, auditable products. Bring a pragmatic commercial lens to how those obligations are met.

• Make the Hard Calls: Decide where ML and automation beat manual review, and drive alignment across Engineering, Commercial, Risk, and Operations without direct authority, even when that means saying “no”.

Who You Are

• Product Leader: 8+ years in product management, including hands-on experience hiring and developing product managers.

• Commercially Minded: Analytical and metrics-driven, with the accountability of a P&L owner.

• Technically Fluent: A solid grasp of ML and data-driven products, and the confidence to work with engineers on petabyte-scale systems.

• Grounded in the Space: A working knowledge of fraud, KYC/KYB, or financial crime. Experience in fintech, payments, or regulated industries is a strong plus.

• Influential Communicator: Clear and confident with technical, commercial, and executive audiences worldwide.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. • 8+ years in partnerships, channel, or alliances roles within enterprise SaaS, cloud, or CX/customer support software

• Commercial fluency — you can draw a straight line from partner activity to closed revenue

• Comfort operating in fast-moving, high-growth environments where the playbook is still being written

• Familiarity with the EMEA market landscape; open to regular travel across the region

• Genuine curiosity about AI and a willingness to use AI tools to work smarter

Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

Self-serve is where the majority of our customers start their journey, and the Growth team owns that journey end to end. This role owns the self-serve existing business: once a customer converts to paid, the account is yours - through every stage of its lifecycle, as it adopts more of the platform, grows its usage, and deepens its reliance on Fin.

Your mandate is to grow the value of the self-serve base: drive expansion, strengthen retention, and accelerate adoption of Fin and our newest products across thousands of paying customers. You'll own a book of business, a roadmap, and a cross-functional motion that spans product, lifecycle, data, and go-to-market. It's a rare Growth remit with a clear number to move and a lot of room to build the motions that move it.

What will I be doing? 

• Own the self-serve existing business book. Own the remit end to end - from the moment a customer converts to the point they renew, expand, or leave - and be accountable for the net growth of that book.

• Grow Fin adoption. Get more customers using our AI Agent across the existing base, and help the customers who already use it automate more of their support.

• Defend and expand. Build the retention and expansion motions that grow the book - combining in-product experiences, lifecycle messaging, and a data/signal layer that flags which accounts need attention and when.

• Connect self-serve and sales. Design smooth, well-defined handovers between self-serve and sales in both directions, so the right customers get the right motion.

• Fix the key journeys. Partner with core product teams to remove friction on the journeys that matter most to self-serve customers - onboarding and activation, Fin setup and go-live, plan changes and expansion, billing and plan management.

• Land new products & features. Drive attach and adoption of new products & features across the self-serve base.

• Understand the customer. Deeply understand the customers you're serving through research, data, and direct interactions, and turn that understanding into a clear, prioritised roadmap you communicate to build alignment.

• Build and ship. Collaborate with engineers and designers to ideate, build, and ship solutions, and leverage AI to increase your efficiency and accelerate product development.

• Measure impact. Evaluate impact through quantitative and qualitative measures, own product quality, and model our company values and R&D principles in how you lead.

What skills do I need? 

There is no minimum years of experience, and no need to have held the PM title. We care about your impact, drive, and potential - former founders, strategy & operations leaders, and consultants are as welcome as career PMs. The common thread is end-to-end ownership of a problem and the outcomes that follow. We'll be looking for evidence you've applied and grown these skills:

• Growth and lifecycle expertise. You've owned retention, expansion, adoption, or monetisation for a self-serve or product-led business, and you know how to move those numbers.

• Sharp customer focus and problem framing. You get to the real customer problem through research, data, and direct conversations before deciding what to build.

• Strong data fluency. You're comfortable working with funnels, cohorts, and customer signals to find opportunity, size it, and measure impact - and you make decisions from evidence, not instinct.

• Compelling roadmaps. You build and communicate a roadmap that makes the what, when, and why obvious to everyone who needs to align behind it.

• Excellent product judgment. You balance customer needs, business impact, and technical constraints, and you know what to ship now versus later.

• Cross-functional leadership. You drive outcomes across product, design, engineering, data, lifecycle marketing, CS, and sales - influencing teams you don't own.

• AI fluency. You understand how LLMs and AI agents work well enough to assess feasibility, make informed product decisions, and use AI to accelerate your own work.

• Outcome-oriented. You define success clearly, share progress openly, and hold yourself to measurable impact.

#LI-Hybrid
Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values. 

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. title: Marketing Program Manager, France
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are hiring a Marketing Program Manager for France to drive regional marketing programs aligned to Elastic’s go-to-market priorities.

Based in Paris, with regular on-site presence for events and sales engagement.Reporting to the Senior Regional Marketing Manager, EMEA North, this role brings strategy to life in France, ensuring strong execution, local relevance and clear pipeline impact.This is a high-ownership, hands-on role. As the on-the-ground marketing representative for France, you will work closely with sales leadership and represent marketing locally.

Strategic thinking and strong delivery go hand in hand in this role. We’re looking for someone who not only delivers, but brings ideas, challenges thinking and contributes to continuously improve on the market. This role plays a key part in driving growth in one of our priority markets.

What You Will Be Doing

• Own and run regional marketing programs in France to drive pipeline, including events, roundtables, conferences, webinars, ABM and partner marketing.

• Take full ownership end-to-end. Shape plans, align on priorities, then deliver and follow up independently.

• Be hands-on across execution. Build and manage campaign setup including email marketing, landing pages, lists, comms, logistics and vendor coordination.

• Be on-site at key events, leading delivery and acting as the main point of contact for speakers, vendors and internal teams.

• Partner closely with sales. Align on priorities, present plans and results, and represent regional marketing locally.

• Ensure strong operational delivery. Campaign setup, tracking, comms and promotion are accurate, on time and on budget.

• Track performance and pipeline impact. Ensure strong follow-up with sales and continuously improve results.

• Collaborate with product marketing, ops, digital and partners, and support joint programs and partner activities in France.

What You Bring

• 8+ years in B2B marketing, ideally in tech. Strong experience in field marketing and running programs end-to-end.

• Hands-on, structured and highly reliable, with strong attention to detail.

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• A proactive mindset with strong ownership, brings ideas and makes sound decisions independently.

• Confidence working with sales leadership and navigating a matrix organisation.

• Fluency in both French and English.

• Experience with Salesforce, Marketo or similar tools. Digitally Savvy. 

• Willingness to travel ~20–25%.

title: Principal Product Manager II, AI/Vectors - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy and roadmap for Elastic's embedding/reranking and vector database and related capabilities. In this senior role, you'll be the go-to expert on search/vector search, guiding the direction for technologies like vector indexing and hybrid retrieval. This position offers the chance to shape a vital part of our product, working closely with engineering and research teams to ensure that our offerings meet the needs of numerous organizations while keeping pace with the evolving landscape of AI.

What You Will Be Doing

• 
Conduct market research to uncover emerging trends in search/vector databases as well as SOTA model research in emerging areas to manage unstructured data, working alongside our model team. 

• 
Evaluate the competitive landscape to enhance product positioning and develop user personas that guide feature decisions. 

• 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align the product strategy with business goals while prioritizing features based on customer feedback and market demands.

• 
Establish long-term product goals and milestones for the vector use cases, document AI and unstructured data management to drive its development. Prioritize features and enhancements based on user feedback and technical feasibility. Allocate resources skillfully to ensure timely updates, while coordinating with engineering teams to validate roadmap assumptions. Communicate updates and expectations clearly to stakeholders and executives.

• 
Own the vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Elastic's vector database as well as core search use cases, from low-level indexing internals to the developer-facing APIs and SDKs. 

• 
Partner deeply with engineering and applied research on trade-offs, be a credible technical peer in those conversations. Define and defend the metrics that matter: recall, latency, index size, ingestion throughput, and total cost of ownership. Advance the competitiveness of Elastic AI and Vector products across all deployments - Serverless and Self-managed.

• 
Define a unified strategy and roadmap across embedding/reranking models and vector indexing/ semantic ingestion, model lifecycle, and end-to-end retrieval quality. 

• 
Manage the operating cadence. Make sure shared metrics and priorities align the research, cloud, and engineering teams. Address trade-offs where model and index decisions intersect. 

What You Bring 

• 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

• 
Master's degree in a relevant discipline preferred

• 
8+ years in product management, with significant time on technical infrastructure, databases, search, or ML/AI platforms. 

• 
You should have good working knowledge of vector search fundamentals. This includes embeddings, ANN indexing, similarity metrics, and trade-offs between recall and latency. Additionally, you need to know about hybrid retrieval. 

• 
You should have a working knowledge of generative models, model fine tuning, model capabilities and document processing for large corpus 

• 
You don't need to be a researcher, but you should hold your own with engineers on these topics. A track record of shipping developer- or infrastructure-facing products that were adopted at scale.
