We’re hiring a Creator Marketing Executive at Monzo. We’re looking for a brilliant creator marketing expert to help us scale our next chapter: showing up less like a standard bank and more like an authoritative, high-craft media publisher.

You’ll support the end-to-end execution of creator campaigns, manage always-on creator relationships, and help build deep trust around the culture of money.

If you are an energetic, detail-oriented creator marketer who loves collaborating with talent, knows how to drive real brand love, and can navigate the nuances of a regulated environment with strong judgment, we invite you to join our team.

The Team 💫

You’ll join a tight-knit, collaborative social and creator team. You’ll report directly to our Head of Social and Influencer, with direct support from our Creator Marketing Manager.

Monzo is growing up, and we’re ready for our next stage of growth. We’re moving away from the old playbook to build a high-quality, always-on social and creator ecosystem with partners at the top of their game. This role is a great opportunity to work with some of the best in the game, and bring a fresh perspective to creator marketing at Monzo.

You’ll play a key role by…

• Executing high-impact campaigns: Support and deliver always-on, reactive, and integrated creator campaigns on time and on budget.

• Driving trust & authority: Help shift brand perceptions and build long-term credibility through authentic creator partnerships and ambassador networks.

• Supporting creator content & craft: Collaborate closely with talent and agencies to co-create high-performing, platform-native content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Substack and more.

• Ensuring rigorous compliance: Act as a detailed guardian for brand alignment, risk, and regulatory guidelines across all creator output.

• Tracking & optimise performance: Monitor campaign KPIs, analyse performance data, and help translate insights into actionable creative strategy.

• Talent research and knowledge: Stay plugged into TikTok, Instagram, and wider internet culture to identify up-and-coming creators and social publishers who align with our brand values.

• Campaign & content Support: Assist in briefing, coordinating, and supporting creators through execution to ensure assets meet creative standards and deadlines.

• Creator management: Support talent onboarding and briefing, and day-to-day relationship management through our agency for our trusted ambassador roster.

• Delivering compliant content: Review creator-generated content thoroughly to ensure full compliance with internal risk and controls teams and industry regulations.

• Agency & cross-functional collaboration: Work seamlessly alongside agency partners, internal brand, writers, social, and growth teams to align creator work with commercial goals.

• Performance reporting: Track metrics, build reporting dashboards, and extract insights on media efficiency, brand lift, and engagement.

• Trend & competitor tracking: Monitor competitor activity and emerging platform features to bring fresh, innovative ideas to the table.

We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have 1–3 years’ experience in creator marketing, influencer partnerships or digital social media.

• You’re proactive and comfortable managing small projects independently, while knowing when to ask for guidance.

• You understand platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn, and what helps creator content stand out.

• You have a strong eye for detail and can stay organised when managing budgets, content deliverables and regulatory requirements.

• You’re a great communicator who can build trusting relationships with creators and collaborate with teams across the business.

• You’re comfortable using social analytics tools and keen to learn how creator storytelling contributes to business results.

• You bring good judgement and empathy to your work, balancing creative, culturally relevant ideas with sensitivity to financial topics and brand risks.

Some nice to haves…

• Prior experience coordinating creator events, activations, or ambassador programs.

• Understanding of social SEO, keyword optimisation, and search intent in creator content.

• Familiarity with creator management tools, social listening software, or analytics suites.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits 

We’re looking for several Product Marketing Leads to set the market intelligence and product strategy for individual product Collectives.

At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead marketing strategy and execution, to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we aim to build and market category-leading products. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.

This is a player/coach role. You'll own Product Marketing for a Collective: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and guiding how launches land in the market. If you love influencing what gets built as much as how it's communicated, you'll feel at home here.

Where you could join:

• Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new kinds of wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work to make growing money (finally) feel simpler and more useful for everyday customers.

• MonzOS is the intelligence layer of Monzo: an AI-powered operating system that helps customers find the right product, insight or action at the right moment. It brings together personalisation, recommendations, search and in-app discovery to make Monzo feel more useful every time someone opens the app. This is a role for someone who is excited by the challenge of making Monzo feel simple, trusted and indispensable in people’s financial lives.

• EU is building Monzo for millions of customers across Europe, taking what people love about Monzo in the UK and making it work brilliantly in new markets. This role will lead consumer market insight and competitor discovery for new countries, while supporting growth in already-live markets like Ireland and Spain. This is a role for someone who loves figuring out how to win a market: turning customer insight, competitor analysis and local context into practical, provocative choices for product and marketing.

Key Responsibilities

You and your team will…

• Set strategy for multiple categories. You'll own a one-year product marketing strategy for a complex, multi-product Collective. You will work to define how Monzo wins in multiple categories with multiple products over time.

• Set the market intelligence agenda. You'll decide what we need to understand about our customers, competitors, and the market. You’ll identify and size opportunities, and build the frameworks other teams use to prioritise and respond.

• Shape what gets built. You'll use market intelligence to shape product strategy across multiple areas, bringing a perspective that changes what we build and in what order. You'll sit alongside Product leadership, driving commercial outcomes through product differentiation.

• Define positioning that moves the business. You'll ensure every product starts with a customer problem, differentiated positioning, and a proposition worth talking about. You’ll demonstrate that positioning will shift customer perception and move revenue at scale.

• Own how we go to market. You'll decide when products launch, with what mechanic, and in what order, so launches across the Collective add up to more than a run of releases. You'll give Integrated Marketing a brief sharp enough that they never have to guess, then feed what the market tells you back into the proposition.

• Raise the bar for Product Marketing. You'll define what great looks like through high standards, coaching, feedback, and better systems. title: Associate Director, Global Partnerships (all genders)
description:
The role

As the Associate Director of Global Partnerships, you will own the new business development agenda for the HelloFresh Group, driving high-value, scalable partnerships across our core growth brands: Factor US, HelloFresh US, and global brand opportunities. Based in our Berlin office and reporting to the Sr. Director Partnerships & Sales, this is a senior individual contributor role where your impact is measured by the quality and scale of the deals you bring in generating net new activations.

You will lead the global BD steerco, setting the agenda, building the process, and holding the function accountable for pipeline quality and progress across all markets and brands. Working with dotted-line relationships across local BD stakeholders globally, you will be the senior commercial voice on all net-new partnership opportunities, reporting progress directly to CMO-level stakeholders across the HelloFresh Group.

Alongside core affiliate, Closed-User-Groups and brand-to-brand partnerships, you will play a founding role in establishing Card-Linked Offers (CLO) as a stable, scalable new channel for the HelloFresh Group, building the commercial model, identifying strategic partners, and working cross-functionally to bring it to market.

This role is not about managing the affiliate channel, it is about landing the deals that open new growth frontiers. If you are a commercially driven BD operator who thrives on identifying opportunity at scale, building relationships at senior level, and turning a pipeline into revenue, this is the role for you.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

Business development & deal-making

• Own and deliver quarterly and annual BD net activations targets across the HelloFresh Group brand portfolio, Factor US, HelloFresh US, and global partnerships

• Build and manage a structured, qualified global partnership pipeline from prospecting through to signed agreement and launch, with a focus on high-value, multi-market opportunities

• Develop commercial partnerships with tech-integration platforms (employee benefits, fintech, telecom) where the primary driver is new customer acquisition — own the commercial deal and partner relationship; technical integration is coordinated with Ops/Engineering, not built by this role. 

• Lead outreach strategy end-to-end: sequencing, messaging, qualification frameworks, and tooling (HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo)

• Identify, evaluate, and prioritize high-potential brand partnerships across target verticals, B2B brands, fitness & wellness, fintech, lifestyle, and media

• Negotiate and finalize complex commercial partnership agreements, ensuring terms meet HelloFresh Group's strategic and financial objectives

• Develop and present compelling pitch materials, business cases, and commercial proposals for new partnership categories and global brand opportunities

CLO channel development

• Lead the commercial build-out of Card-Linked Offers (CLO) as a net-new, scalable growth channel for the HelloFresh Group

• Develop the CLO partnership strategy, commercial model, and go-to-market framework in collaboration with Operations, Analytics, and local market teams

• Manage and grow senior-level commercial relationships with CLO partners, acting as the primary point of contact at HelloFresh Group level

• Track channel performance and report on CLO pipeline health and revenue contribution alongside broader BD metrics

Global BD steerco & stakeholder management

• Own and lead the Global BD Steerco, setting agenda, running cadence, building process, and ensuring pipeline coordination across Factor, HelloFresh US, and INTL markets

• Work with dotted-line local BD stakeholders globally to align on priorities, prevent pipeline overlap, and implement consistent outreach and qualification standards

• Report pipeline progress, BD metrics, and strategic deal updates to CMO-level stakeholders across the HelloFresh Group

• Represent HelloFresh Group at international industry conferences, partner meetings, and networking events, with regular travel to the US market

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Analytics, Legal, Procurement and local market teams to ensure smooth deal execution and post-launch performance tracking

How success is measured

• New partner contracts signed (deal-value weighted)

• Incremental new customer conversions from BD-sourced partnerships

• iROI / iCAC per partnership

• BD pipeline value and stage-conversion rate

What you’ll bring

• 10+ years of experience in business development, affiliate marketing, or strategic partnerships, ideally within digital marketing, e-commerce, subscription, or a similarly complex commercial environment

• Proven track record of sourcing, pitching, and closing high-value, multi-market partnerships with globally recognised brands, from prospecting through to live

• Deep knowledge of the affiliate and partnerships landscape: commercial models (CPA, CUG, CLO, tenancy), tracking platforms, network dynamics, and industry best practice

• Card-Linked Offer (CLO) experience or strong commercial understanding of the CLO channel model, including partner economics, technical setup, and consumer proposition

• CRM-driven pipeline management: proven success building and maintaining a structured pipeline in HubSpot or equivalent; disciplined about data quality and reporting

• Senior stakeholder management: comfortable operating at C-level both internally (CMOs, SVPs) and externally (brand and agency leadership), with the credibility and communication skills to match

• A self-starter with high commercial judgment: you identify opportunity, build structure where none exists, and move opportunities forward without being chased

• Strong analytical skills: able to interpret pipeline data, campaign performance, and ROI metrics to prioritize opportunities and make commercially sound decisions

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

title: Lead Creative Strategy, New Social Platforms (all genders)
description:
The role

We're rebuilding HelloFresh's paid social engine around the reality that creative is the single largest performance lever on TikTok. TikTok's algorithm rewards platform-native concepts and the brands winning today treat the brief, the editor, and the ad account as one continuous workflow.

This role owns the upstream half of that workflow: turning brand strategy, performance data, and channel diversity needs into a steady, distinctive pipeline of concepts for TikTok and emerging platforms like Pinterest and Snap. You don't run media - you make sure the media team always has the most testable, on-brand, platform-native ideas in the queue and that what works keeps getting iterated on

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

• Concept development and briefing: Translate the brand foundation, persona blueprint, and cohort-level performance data into briefs for TikTok-first video, UGC, Spark Ads, and creator partnerships. Push the team away from "repurposed Reels" toward native TikTok concepts. Develop distinct concepts monthly for local markets with a structured cadence of net new ideation vs iterations.

• Creative pipeline orchestration: Own the brief from concept to source: determining the right direction and matching it to the right production partner (internal studio, influencer, agency partners, TikTok Creative Exchange) based on the needs of the account. Work closely with creative operations to ensure briefs are executed on time and volume targets are met without sacrificing creative diversity or fatigue-window speed.

• Hands-on collaboration with editors and producers: Be integrated in the creative process and come with a strong point of view on assets: push back on first drafts, defend hooks, kill weak openers, and own the final execution of an asset. You know what a winning TikTok hook looks like and why it's different from a Reels hook — before it goes live, and can articulate why.

• Performance-to-brief feedback loop: Mine ad-level data (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, CVR by cohort) to identify what's working and what to retire. Close the loop weekly so the next sprint's briefs are grounded in evidence, not opinion.

• Format and source diversification: Drive the shift toward video-first, UGC-style, and Spark Ads with creator-led content on TikTok. Build platform-fit creative strategy for Pinterest and Snap pilots as they scale, adapting concepts to each platform rather than porting Meta assets over.

• Future-channel creative scouting: Stay ahead on what's next - Reddit, emerging short-video platforms — and maintain a point of view on what creative approach earns a pilot slot.

• Brand coherence at speed: Keep creatives on-strategy across multiple markets while preserving the velocity TikTok and new platforms demand.

What you’ll bring

• 5+ years in paid social creative strategy at a high-spend D2C, subscription, or performance-led brand. Direct experience briefing and reviewing UGC, creator content, and short-form video is non-negotiable.

• Deep hands-on TikTok creative fluency — you understand Spark Ads, TikTok Creative Exchange, and the creative fatigue window that makes speed non-negotiable. Working knowledge of Pinterest and Snap creative formats is a plus.

• Strong creative instinct paired with comfort reading performance data — you can defend a concept and kill it when the numbers say so.

• Track record of working hands-on with editors, producers, and creators — not just managing decks. Familiarity with Motion, Smartly, or similar creative analytics is a plus.

• Sharp understanding of how TikTok's algorithm rewards native creative and creative diversity, and how that translates into briefing strategy.

• Comfortable steering peers across Brand, Influencer, and external partners without direct authority.

title: Senior CRM Manager - Transformation (all genders)
description:
The role

We are looking for a Senior CRM Manager - Transformation to make CRM Self-Service at HelloFresh a reality.

Our central Growth function has a clear vision: Enabling our local marketing and product teams to reach our customers directly, via push notifications, in-app messaging and emails. For this to work in an efficient and customer-centric way, the right guardrails, tools and knowledge need to be in place.

Your first mission is to design, launch and scale our CRM self-service model. You’ll do this hand in hand with our CreativeTech squad (Product and Engineering), who are building the future CRM environment in an AI-native way. You’ll work closely with the squad, and potentially be embedded in it. You’ll be the voice of CRM and of our internal users, helping define what this environment needs to look like so teams can send communications safely and independently.

This is 0-to-1 work in a highly ambiguous space where no one has been before: no playbook, no rules. AI and LLMs change fast and often, so you’ll think about what we need in the future, even if today’s models aren’t ready yet, and be prepared for when they catch up. The learning curve will be steep, but you’ll climb it on the go, together with the team. Our goal: protect our environment from the agents, and protect the agents from our environment. 

From there, your focus will follow where CRM needs it most. You’ll take on further transformation projects, so this role is for someone who enjoys building something new and then moving on to the next challenge.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do

• Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.

• Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.

• Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.

• Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.

• Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.

• Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.

• Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.

• Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.

• As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

• A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.

• 4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.

• Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.

• A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.

• Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.

• Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.

• A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.

• Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).

• A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.

• Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.

• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.

Nice to have:

• Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.

• Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.

• Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.

• GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

• Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.

• Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.

• Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.

• Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.

• Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
HelloFresh Ireland is in an exciting growth phase - expanding customer choice, deepening menu relevance, and driving long-term loyalty in a fast-growing market. As our Senior Product Manager, you will own the product space, driving impact across product strategy, product operations, and culinary workstreams. You will lead a talented, dedicated team and serve as the strategic engine behind what makes our boxes brilliant for Irish customers.

This is not a technology product role. You will work across the full physical product value chain and lifecycle - from ingredient sourcing and culinary development through to menu strategy, editorial execution, and customer experience - making decisions that directly impact what lands on our customers' doorsteps every week. You will need the ability to operate at pace, cut through complexity, and bring teams and stakeholders with you.

What You Will Be Doing:

• Strategic business planning: Reviewing product KPIs and guiding the team to improve the product offering - balancing short-term operations with long-term strategic direction, and owning the product investment calendar to increase retention while optimising for revenue and costs.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborating and building strong relationships with Operations, Marketing, and international teams - being the voice of the physical product for HelloFresh Ireland, advising on coherent processes between functions, and ensuring a coordinated approach to product initiatives across local and global stakeholders.

• Process optimisation: Identifying opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve how we work - across teams and with key partners - and aligning operational improvements with the strategic direction.

• Analytical decision making: Working with the team to ensure access to the relevant information, analyses, and insights needed to make informed product development decisions and translate the product vision into action.

• Business case development: Developing business cases around physical product improvements and product-related processes (e.g. changes in product offering, tooling, and automations), and making data-led recommendations to Ireland and global teams.

• People management: Leading, developing and inspiring teams spanning Culinary, Physical Product Strategy, and Product Operations - setting clear strategic direction, cultivating a high-performing culture, and supporting each team member's growth across different career stages.

Who You Are:

• Senior experience in product, category, or commercial - ideally food, FMCG, meal kits, or subscription.

• A genuine passion for food, with the ability to translate taste trends and market signals into compelling product offerings.

• Proven people leadership across different career stages - coaching, clear direction, and investment in growth.

• Strong commercial acumen - connecting product decisions to business outcomes including revenue and retention.

• Excellent cross-functional influence - aligning teams toward a shared goal without needing formal authority.

• Organised and structured, with strong project management skills and the ability to deliver to tight deadlines.

• Strong analytical skills - able to drill into detail, connect findings to the big picture, and present insights clearly.

• Customer-centric, with creative thinking to identify unmet needs and develop solutions that address them.

• A bias for action - moving quickly without sacrificing quality, bringing momentum to the teams around you.

• Sharp problem-solving instincts - comfortable with ambiguity and confident driving toward solutions.

• At home in lean, agile environments - able to do more with less and build from the ground up.

• Comfortable in Excel and Google Suite.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you will get in return:

• The chance to have a serious impact on one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Europe in an exciting growth phase

• Direct, high impact on our Operations setup from day one

• A vibrant, international environment with mission-driven colleagues

• A guaranteed steep learning curve & boost for your career

• Benefit from our selection of employee perks (70% off your HelloFresh boxes, private health insurance, employer matching pension program, cycle to work scheme, Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme, gym membership etc.)

Location: Dublin Docklands, Ireland

To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in ROI, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

Hybrid Working Policy

title: TikTok & New Growth Channels Creative Strategist (all genders)
description:
The role

We're rebuilding HelloFresh's paid social engine around the reality that creative is the single largest performance lever on TikTok. TikTok's algorithm rewards platform-native concepts and the brands winning today treat the brief, the editor, and the ad account as one continuous workflow.

This role owns the upstream half of that workflow: turning brand strategy, performance data, and channel diversity needs into a steady, distinctive pipeline of concepts for TikTok and emerging platforms like Pinterest and Snap. You don't run media - you make sure the media team always has the most testable, on-brand, platform-native ideas in the queue and that what works keeps getting iterated on

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

• Concept development and briefing: Translate the brand foundation, persona blueprint, and cohort-level performance data into briefs for TikTok-first video, UGC, Spark Ads, and creator partnerships. Push the team away from "repurposed Reels" toward native TikTok concepts. Develop distinct concepts monthly for local markets with a structured cadence of net new ideation vs iterations.

• Creative pipeline orchestration: Own the brief from concept to source: determining the right direction and matching it to the right production partner (internal studio, influencer, agency partners, TikTok Creative Exchange) based on the needs of the account. Work closely with creative operations to ensure briefs are executed on time and volume targets are met without sacrificing creative diversity or fatigue-window speed.

• Hands-on collaboration with editors and producers: Be integrated in the creative process and come with a strong point of view on assets: push back on first drafts, defend hooks, kill weak openers, and own the final execution of an asset. You know what a winning TikTok hook looks like and why it's different from a Reels hook — before it goes live, and can articulate why.

• Performance-to-brief feedback loop: Mine ad-level data (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, CVR by cohort) to identify what's working and what to retire. Close the loop weekly so the next sprint's briefs are grounded in evidence, not opinion.

• Format and source diversification: Drive the shift toward video-first, UGC-style, and Spark Ads with creator-led content on TikTok. Build platform-fit creative strategy for Pinterest and Snap pilots as they scale, adapting concepts to each platform rather than porting Meta assets over.

• Future-channel creative scouting: Stay ahead on what's next - Reddit, emerging short-video platforms — and maintain a point of view on what creative approach earns a pilot slot.

• Brand coherence at speed: Keep creatives on-strategy across multiple markets while preserving the velocity TikTok and new platforms demand.

What you’ll bring

• 5+ years in paid social creative strategy at a high-spend D2C, subscription, or performance-led brand. Direct experience briefing and reviewing UGC, creator content, and short-form video is non-negotiable.

• Deep hands-on TikTok creative fluency — you understand Spark Ads, TikTok Creative Exchange, and the creative fatigue window that makes speed non-negotiable. Working knowledge of Pinterest and Snap creative formats is a plus.

• Strong creative instinct paired with comfort reading performance data — you can defend a concept and kill it when the numbers say so.

• Track record of working hands-on with editors, producers, and creators — not just managing decks. Familiarity with Motion, Smartly, or similar creative analytics is a plus.

• Sharp understanding of how TikTok's algorithm rewards native creative and creative diversity, and how that translates into briefing strategy.

• Comfortable steering peers across Brand, Influencer, and external partners without direct authority.

What we offer

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

• You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.

• Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.

• Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.

Health & Wellbeing

• Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.

• Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.

Flexibility & Work-Life

• Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.

• Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.

• Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.

Career & Development

• Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.

Culture & Environment

• Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.

• We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.

title: B2B Marketing Automation Manager
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is the leading local commerce platform in several markets across Europe and Asia. Wolt makes it incredibly easy for you to discover and get what you want. Delivered to you – quickly, reliably and affordably. And by doing so, we make cities better places to live.

Wolt is embarking on a very exciting journey: to build one of the most important Retail Media ecosystems in the 23 countries we operate, so brands can leverage consumer insights, connect with shoppers via advertising in-app and off-app and deliver unforgettable brand experiences to our millions of shoppers. 

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced B2B Lifecycle Marketing Automation Manager to join our Wolt Ads team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the Wolt Ads Lead Lifecycle process and for our customer relationship management (CRM) activities to drive engagement, retention, and revenue growth. The Marketing Automation Manager will work closely with the marketing and sales teams to develop and execute effective communications campaigns that increase customer loyalty and lifetime value.

About the team

Our Wolt Ads Product team is responsible for building our Ads business across 23 countries. Together with our in-market sales teams, the Marketing Automation Manager is responsible for setting up automated marketing communication programs that create, grow and retain Wolt Ads customers for both restaurants, retail and brands, as well as integrating communications with our Sales and Account management processes. 

You will understand lead generation, including lead scoring and qualification, and partner with local Ad managers and Sales Ops. You'll provide guidance, reporting and lead-stage insights so Salesforce follow-up on leads is consistent across countries.

You will need to be a strong communicator with the ability to create and analyze reports about the customer lifecycle and client re-engagement. SQL is a plus, as are BI skills such as Looker and strong Excel skills.

In this role, you will be reporting to our B2B Lifecycle Marketing Lead, and working with key stakeholders across B2B Marketing, Global Ads and Wolt Ads Strategy teams.

What you’ll be doing

• Own and develop the Wolt Ads lifecycle marketing strategy across restaurants, retail partners, brands and agencies, focusing on activation, retention, reactivation and growth.

• Build and optimise automated, personalised customer journeys across channels such as email, in-app messaging, push notifications and SMS.

• Partner with Sales and Sales Operations to improve lead nurturing, qualification and handoff, ensuring a consistent experience across markets.

• Use customer data and segmentation to identify opportunities, personalise campaigns and improve the customer experience throughout the lifecycle.

• Measure and report on lifecycle performance, including conversion, retention and revenue, using insights and A/B testing to improve results.

• Work with Data and Engineering teams to maintain accurate customer data and reliable integrations between Salesforce, Customer.io and other systems.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Product and local teams to plan and deliver campaigns that scale across markets, while following data privacy and communication best practices.

• Manage and develop a Junior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, providing coaching, feedback and clear priorities.

Scope and accountability:

You will be accountable for: revenue influenced by lifecycle programmes; lead-to-first-campaign conversion and time to first campaign; retention and repeat-campaign rate; data quality and sync health in Customer.io; and the output and development of one direct report.

You will independently: diagnose funnel drop-offs and redesign journeys to fix them; prioritise competing requests from Sales, Product and Marketing against a single communications calendar; and adapt programmes to local languages, regulations and sales processes across 23 countries.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 4-6 years of experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing, in a B2B, ads or SaaS environment.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to inform decision-making.

• SQL and BI skills (e.g. Looker) are a plus.

• Hands-on experience with a marketing automation platform such as Customer.io (or similar) and with Salesforce.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Experience designing A/B and incrementality tests and measuring revenue influence.

• Knowledge of GDPR and other data protection regulations and best practices.

• Experience coaching or mentoring junior team members.

What we offer

• An opportunity to be part of one of the fastest-growing media ecosystems in Europe

• Hands-on experience in digital advertising operations and campaign optimization

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

• The chance to make a tangible impact on partner success and Wolt’s advertising business

• Great benefits and clear opportunities for career growth

Why you’ll love it

• 🚀Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving scaleup

• 🤩Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career and build your sales skills 

• 💪Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference

• 💙Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

Next steps

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Join us in shaping the experience millions of customers worldwide land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt or Deliveroo.

You’ll be embedded in our global Discovery team, part of the Core Consumer organisation, working side by side with US product managers on a shared global tech stack. Together, we own how customers search, explore and discover everything we have to offer, from their favourite local spot to something they didn’t know they wanted.

Your roadmap will be a mix of consumer problems felt most in EMEA but worth solving globally, global capabilities we’re accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems where speed matters.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who loves consumer products end to end, from spotting the customer problem to shaping the experience, shipping it and measuring the impact.

What You'll Be Doing

• Own vision and strategy: Define and drive the roadmap and OKRs for your area of discovery, from early problem discovery through to scaled impact.

• Build end-to-end experiences: Shape how customers find everything on DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo, partnering closely with Design and Ux Research and holding a high bar on the details.

• Shape AI-powered discovery: Work with Engineering, Data Science and ML on ranking, personalisation and recommendations, and define how GenAI and agentic experiences come to life for customers.

• Customer first, business-aware: Start with what’s right for the customer, and find solutions that work for the business too, so wins don’t come at the customer’s expense.

• Build for scale: Understand customer problems across EMEA markets and beyond, spot the patterns, and build solutions that scale globally rather than one-off fixes.

• Combine data with strong judgment: Lead experiment-driven development, make clear ship decisions, and know when to optimise incrementally versus rethink an approach entirely.

• Align stakeholder: Communicate strategy, trade-offs and learnings clearly to build conviction across the wider team and senior leadership.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential Requirements

• Customer-first thinking: You start with the customer, always. You seek out customer insight, empathise deeply with real needs and frustrations, and spot opportunities others miss.

• Consumer product ownership: A proven track record of delivering measurable outcomes on B2C, consumer-facing products at scale.

• End-to-end generalist: You care as much about the UX and UI customers see as about the systems underneath: the data, ML models and platform capabilities that power the experience. You grasp technical concepts quickly and partner effectively with Engineering and ML.

• Analytical and commercial rigour: Strong quantitative skills, comfort with experimentation, and sound business instincts to make consequential calls.

• High-velocity execution: Demonstrated ownership of shipping at pace, with a sharp eye for detail.

• Stakeholder leadership: You build trust with people whose priorities differ from yours, and align senior stakeholders on difficult trade-offs: collaborative, with a clear point of view.

• Resilience in ambiguity: You thrive in a high-ownership environment where the problems are big and the industry is changing fast.

Nice to Have

• Experience with discovery, homepage, feed, ranking or recommendation products.

• Hands-on experience building GenAI or LLM-powered consumer experiences.

• Experience in a multi-sided marketplace or a global/regional product setup.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

• Solve meaningful problems at real scale: Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

• See your impact, fast: Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

• Grow through challenge and ownership: Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

• A culture built for builders: High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager, EMEA Growth & Engagement
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to join our EMEA Growth & Engagement team, which owns the growth and engagement of Wolt+ and Deliveroo Plus across 40+ markets in Europe and the Middle East and is working to build the best local commerce membership programs in the markets we operate in.

You will join our Engagement pod, which focuses on understanding what turns a subscriber into a healthy, engaged and long-term member. You will be responsible for i) identifying and prioritising the largest opportunities to improve our member experience and subscription health, ii) understanding how customer needs and behaviours evolve across different stages of the Plus lifecycle, and iii) driving the highest-priority opportunities from strategy through experimentation and execution to tangible business results.

To get the job done, you’ll work closely with our wider subscription team and cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, Commercial and Finance, while taking full ownership of driving your initiatives to fruition and, most importantly, measurable results.

Our team is responsible for driving the growth and long-term health of our subscription programs. Your exact problem space may evolve as our priorities change, but in practice you will:

• Build a clear view of the largest opportunities to improve member engagement and subscription health across EMEA. Use customer behaviour, market performance and economics to size opportunities and prioritise the areas most likely to materially move our business results.

• Understand the member lifecycle end to end, identifying where customers struggle to onboard, build habit, discover value or remain engaged, and translate those insights into practical interventions that improve customer and business outcomes.

• Own initiatives from initial problem definition through to execution and results, working closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, Commercial and Finance.

• Build and run an experimentation roadmap against the highest-priority opportunities. Translate business problems into clear hypotheses, design A/B tests or other appropriate experiments, analyse the results and make decisions on whether initiatives should be scaled, iterated or stopped.

• Track and own the key performance indicators relevant to your problem space and, where necessary, drive corrective actions. This may mean pulling shorter-term lifecycle levers or shaping longer-term Product and Engineering solutions to address underlying drivers.

• Collaborate closely with local and regional teams to ensure our strategies reflect customer needs and market context, and turn successful approaches into repeatable playbooks that can scale across Wolt+ and Deliveroo Plus.

• Keep a close eye on our customer experience and identify opportunities to make Plus easier to understand, use and get value from throughout the membership lifecycle.

The Engagement pod works across a broad range of customer problems. Examples could include improving the first 30–60 days of membership, onboarding and early order progression, benefit discovery and adoption, lifecycle and CRM journeys, programs that drive incremental order frequency and activity, and initiatives that improve longer-term member engagement and retention.

Our humble expectations

• 5+ years of relevant experience, preferably in i) strategy & operations, consumer growth or engagement at a leading consumer technology / platform company, ii) subscriptions, loyalty or membership businesses, or iii) management consulting with subsequent operating experience.

• Problem-solving and prioritisation skills: our team is in the business of solving hard problems and developing new solutions. There is rarely a ready-made playbook to follow, so you’ll need to be comfortable structuring ambiguous problems, getting into the details and identifying which opportunities are most likely to move the needle.

• Analytical and experimentation skills: you’ll work with data every day and need to be comfortable identifying and sizing opportunities, designing and interpreting A/B tests and making decisions based on the results. Strong spreadsheet skills are a must-have and SQL experience is useful.

• Customer and lifecycle judgement: you are able to understand how customer behaviour and needs evolve across the membership journey, identify the moments that matter most and translate those insights into practical ways to improve onboarding, engagement and retention.

• Business ownership and independence: you have experience owning measurable business results and can demonstrate how you have taken a problem from initial analysis through to execution and impact. You’ll be given significant responsibility and freedom, so you need to be comfortable operating without a predefined roadmap.

• People and project management skills: you’ll need to be able to inspire and persuade colleagues from a broad spectrum of backgrounds and seniority levels and get cross-functional teams working towards one goal in a coordinated and efficient way.

• AI fluency: AI is increasingly part of how we work at Wolt day to day. You should already be comfortable using AI tools in your work, or be excited to quickly become so, and continuously look for ways to use them to work faster and solve problems better.

• Business acumen and eye for superb user experience: you’ll need to be able to see the forest for the trees and have good intuition about what works best for customers while understanding the economics and trade-offs behind business decisions.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Director Indirect Sales & Partnerships (x/f/m)
description:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als Director Indirect Sales & Partnerships (x/f/m) als Unterstützung für unser Team in Berlin.

Als Director Indirect Sales & Partnerships (x/f/m) übernimmst Du eine zentrale strategische Führungsrolle: Du transformierst Doctolibs Go-to-Market-Ansatz in Deutschland – und baust einen skalierbaren, quoten-gesteuerten indirekten Vertriebskanal mit IT-Systemhäusern als Kern auf. Du führst ein Team von fünf Mitarbeitenden und baust ein Netzwerk von 50–60 stabilen IT-Systempartnern auf, die gemeinsam mit Doctolib flächendeckend die Digitalisierung des deutschen Gesundheitswesens vorantreiben. Mit Deiner Arbeit schaffst Du einen wachsenden Umsatzpfeiler, der das Direktvertriebsvolumen langfristig ergänzt – und prägst damit maßgeblich die strategische Ausrichtung von Doctolib Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du entwickelst und skalierst einen leistungsstarken indirekten Vertriebskanal mit ausgewählten Top-IT-Systemhäusern (ITSPs) in ganz Deutschland und stellst damit eine flächendeckende regionale Abdeckung sicher

• Du transformierst das bestehende Geschäftsmodell von einem Direktvertriebsmodell zu einem echten indirekten Vertriebskanal mit klaren Quoten, strukturiertem Forecasting und datengetriebenem Performance-Steering

• Du verhandelst und schließt strategische Partnerschaften mit führenden IT-Dienstleistern – inklusive kommerzieller Konstrukte, Priorisierung von Integrationen und konkreter Rollout-Pläne und bist damit mehrere Tage im Monat vor Ort bei den potentiellen Partnern

• Du konzipierst skalierbare Partner-Management-Frameworks, differenzierte Anreizstrukturen und effiziente operative Prozesse für Dein Team

• Du führst, entwickelst und inspirierst ein Team von rund 5 FTEs und baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf Geschäftsführerebene mit den Managing Directors der Systemhauspartner auf

• Du arbeitest eng mit den deutschen Führungsteams aus Sales, Product, Marketing und Tech zusammen und wirkst als Mitglied des German Leadership Teams aktiv an der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von Doctolib Deutschland mit

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

• Mehr als 10 Jahre nachgewiesene Senior-Führungserfahrung im Aufbau und der Skalierung von indirekten Vertriebskanälen und Partnerkanälen – idealerweise in B2B SaaS, Enterprise Software, IT-Lösungen (Cloud Services) oder im IT-Systemhaus-Umfeld

• Tiefgreifende Expertise in der Zusammenarbeit mit IT-Systemhäusern (ITSPs), einschließlich der Gestaltung von Partneranreizprogrammen, kommerziellen Vertragsstrukturen und Deployment-Plänen

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Transformation von Vertriebsorganisationen, im Change Management sowie im Aufbau und der Führung von leistungsstarken Sales- und Partnerteams

• Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, Begeisterung für den Aufbau von Beziehungen von Grund auf sowie unternehmerisches Denken und hohe Eigeninitiative

• Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, um Vertriebsprozesse zu optimieren, Partnerperformance datenbasiert zu steuern und Dein Team in der Nutzung neuer Technologien weiterzuentwickeln

• Du arbeitest datengetrieben, entwirfst skalierbare Prozesse und iterierst schnell auf Basis von Ergebnissen

• Du bist eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit: Du rekrutierst, coachst und entwickelst Dein Team und schaffst eine leistungsorientierte, motivierende Teamkultur

• Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch auf C1-Niveau

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

• Vorerfahrung im Healthcare- oder Medical-Software-Sektor

title: Lead Marketing Data Analyst (x/f/m)
description:
Vos missions

Nous recherchons un(e) Lead Marketing Data Analyst pour rejoindre l'équipe B2B Performance Marketing. En tant que Lead Marketing Data Analyst, vous êtes la référence analytique de l'équipe sur la performance d'acquisition, l'attribution et la valeur client. 

Vous transformez des données cross-canal complexes en concepts clairs et en recommandations concrètes qui influencent directement les décisions d'investissement, de ciblage et de croissance de l'équipe. Vous êtes le socle data sur lequel s'appuient le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et le Digital Analyst : vous garantissez que la bonne donnée est disponible, fiable et exploitable par tous.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Data Product Managers pour trouver les bonnes solutions et aligner les équipes Data sur des définitions communes, des métriques partagées et une structuration cohérente de la donnée. Vous êtes également le partenaire des Sales Operations (équipe SCOPS) pour construire l'infrastructure de “lead scoring” qui connecte Marketing et Sales.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement AI-first : les modèles ML, les pipelines automatisés et l'analyse assistée par IA feront partie de votre quotidien.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

1. Attribution, parcours de conversion & incrémentalité (30%)

• Piloter le modèle d'attribution multi-touch de l'équipe entre SEO, acquisition payante et CRM

• Construire et maintenir une vue unifiée des parcours de conversion, exploitable depuis le data warehouse

• Définir et documenter les définitions de conversion communes sur lesquelles toute l'équipe s'aligne

• Accompagner les équipes Paid et CRM dans la mesure de leur impact (tests d'incrémentalité, Marketing Mix Modeling, Causal Impact…)

• Travailler avec les Data Product Managers pour s'assurer que les modèles de données et les flux associés sont correctement structurés et maintenus

2. LTV/SAC, analyses de cohortes & reporting à la Direction (25%)

• Suivre la LTV et le SAC par canal d'acquisition, segment et cohorte

• Construire et maintenir les courbes de rétention par cohorte (J7, J30, J90) et identifier les moments de churn

• Déterminer quelles sources d'acquisition et quels segments génèrent la plus forte valeur à long terme

• Développer des modèles de prévision en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Data et Finance

• Produire le reporting LTV/SAC mensuel qui guide les décisions d'allocation budgétaire et préparer les synthèses de performance partagées avec la Direction

3. Scoring des leads & partenariat avec les équipes commerciales (20%)

• Concevoir et déployer un modèle de scoring des leads basé sur le machine learning avec l'équipe SCOPS, pour déterminer quels leads sont transmis aux commerciaux et lesquels sont nurturés en CRM

• Traduire les données comportementales et d'engagement en un modèle de scoring activable dans le CRM, en coordination avec le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI 

• Faire évoluer le modèle au fil des nouvelles données et des retours des équipes commerciales

4. Disponibilité de la donnée & support de l'équipe (15%)

• Être le partenaire data du spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et du Digital Analyst : garantir que la donnée dont ils ont besoin est disponible, bien documentée et fiable

• Traduire leurs besoins en exigences structurées pour les Data Product Managers

• Identifier les problèmes de qualité de données en amont et les suivre jusqu'à leur résolution

• Être le lien entre l'équipe Performance Marketing et l'organisation Data

5. Tableaux de bord opérationnels & suivi de la performance (10%)

• Piloter les tableaux de bord de performance globale de l'équipe : acquisition, attribution, LTV/SAC et contribution par canal (suivi quotidien, pilotage hebdomadaire, vue mensuelle pour la direction)

• Mettre en place une détection automatique des anomalies, des synthèses narratives générées par IA et des analyses exploratoires assistées pour libérer du temps sur des travaux analytiques à plus forte valeur ajoutée

Les qualités attendues pour ce poste

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

• Justifiez de 7 à 10 ans d'expérience en analytics marketing, growth analytics ou business analytics idéalement dans des scale-ups B2B SaaS

• Avez l'habitude de piloter un travail analytique de bout en bout, du modèle de données à la présentation à la Direction

• Maîtrisez les requêtes SQL de manière autonome au quotidien et avez travaillé directement avec BigQuery ou équivalent

• Avez une expérience concrète en attribution et/ou en incrémentalité : vous avez construit ou piloté un modèle d'attribution multi-touch, mené des tests d'incrémentalité (user-based, geolift) ou travaillé sur du Marketing Mix Modeling

• Avez une expérience en optimisation du funnel marketing :

• Stratégie d'acquisition & d'activation

• Modélisation de la LTV / SAC dans un contexte SaaS ou par abonnement : avoir réalisé des analyses LTV et SAC basées sur des cohortes, utilisées pour orienter l'allocation budgétaire ou des décisions stratégiques.

• Définition des KPIs et cadre de référence (MQLs, SQLs, Leads...)

• Expérience avec des outils de visualisation de données : Amplitude, Tableau, Looker, Metabase…

• Maîtrisez l'anglais et le français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral

Ce serait fantastique si vous aviez aussi :

• Des compétences en Python ou R pour la modélisation statistique avancée et le développement de modèles de machine learning

• Une connaissance des modèles de croissance tirés par le produit (product-led growth) et de la façon dont les données d'usage alimentent la mesure marketing

• Une expérience de management ou d'accompagnement d'analystes plus juniors

• Des notions d'allemand

Notre offre

• 25 jours de congés payés et 12 à 14 jours de RTT par an

• Un programme de santé mentale et de coaching personnalisé gratuit avec notre partenaire Moka.care

• 10 jours par an de télétravail à l’étranger possible

• Adhésion au plan de partage de la valeur de Doctolib, appelé DoctoGrowth

• Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 8,50 € par jour, dont 4,50 € pris en charge par Doctolib

• Un programme d'intégration complet de 3 mois incluant la Doctolib Academy et diverses formations (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

• Une subvention du comité d’entreprise pour le remboursement d'une partie de l'inscription à un club de sport ou à une activité créative

• Un remboursement à 50 % de l'abonnement aux transports en commun

• Un mois de congé supplémentaire au congé parental légal grâce au programme "Parent Care"

• Pour les salariés en situation de handicap ou proches aidants, un package comprenant une adaptation du télétravail, des jours d'absence autorisée payés pour les rendez-vous médicaux et un soutien psychologique renforcé

• Aide au déménagement en cas de mobilité internationale

Le processus de recrutement

title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain.

Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. 

A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.

You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. 

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four

• Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard

• Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities

• Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity

• Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature

• Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

• You have owned a coverage, completeness or data quality metric as your primary objective, and can say what it went from, to what, and over how long

• You have worked at millions-of-records scale

• You have moved that metric through teams that did not report to you, setting interfaces, contracts and SLAs with partner teams

• You have shipped under a hard regulatory or consent constraint, in health, finance or identity, with privacy and consent by design

• You have real technical depth: you have owned a data platform component as a product, a feature store, a context or profile service, or an identity layer. 

• You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

• You have had a data quality problem surface only once it reached a downstream consumer, and you changed how you worked because of it

• You have built a completeness or quality definition and made an organisation adopt it

• You have worked on interoperability, health data standards, or identity and account models

What we offer

• Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

• 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

• Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

• Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

• Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

• A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

• 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

• ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

• For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

• Relocation support in case of international mobility

• Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

• Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime Balme)

• Hiring Manager Interview (Léo Lanzarotti) 

• Case Study with Product Panel

• Behavioral Interview with peers, including at least one channel-owning team

• At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

• Permanent position

• Full-time

• Levallois-Perret, France

• Hybrid work setup (2 remote days per week)

• Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: Germany l France l Italy l Netherlands. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft 

Doctolib sucht Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Praktikant:in im Bereich Product Marketing für unseren Standort in Berlin. 

Als Teil des Product Marketing Teams bei Doctolib trägst du dazu bei, innovative Lösungen für das Gesundheitswesen noch wirkungsvoller zu machen. Unser Ziel ist es, die Markteinführung neuer Produkte strategisch zu steuern und sicherzustellen, dass unsere Angebote echten Mehrwert für Gesundheitsfachkräfte und Patient:innen schaffen. title: Senior Product Manager - Product Led Growth- Paris (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product team at Doctolib.

Your mission: scale Doctolib's acquisition engine into a measurable, lower-cost growth driver across France, Germany and Italy. You will own the end-to-end product-led and marketing-led growth funnel, from freemium offer design to subscription and in-product upsell, contributing directly to growing ARR while bringing the cost to acquire new practitioners down.

Building at Doctolib means shipping products that change how care teams and patients experience healthcare every day.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Own Doctolib freemium offer: define what is free, metered, or demo-only, and design the conversion paths that move practitioners to a paid plan

• Own and improve the subscription funnel for new business and upsell, across web and in-product surfaces, including checkout and sign-up unification

• Design and improve every in-product flow that moves an existing customer to a higher-value plan

• Define acquisition-side packaging: offer catalogue, eligibility rules, and contract signature flows across France, Germany and Italy

• Lead marketing-led growth initiatives, including lead generation, B2B website conversion, and lifecycle marketing, connecting them to the core product funnel

• Set the direction for cross-team delivery (along with the PMMs and other counterparts), deciding offer by offer and country by country when conversion is the right path, and when to route a user to sales as a warm, product-qualified lead

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

• You have owned a PLG conversion, ARR or CAC metric as your primary objective in B2B SaaS at scale, and can quantify what it moved, from what baseline, over what period

• You have scaled product-led growth alongside a sales motion, and can explain how you chose between autonomous conversion and handing sales a warm lead, offer by offer

• You read data yourself, define funnel measurement from scratch, and make decisions with experiments rather than opinion

• You have solid product judgement on pricing, packaging, eligibility and freemium boundaries, and can work within a regulated environment with consent and country-specific constraints in mind

• You set direction for teams you do not manage and move a metric across a cross-functional chain

• You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

• Have owned both product-led and marketing-led growth, connecting lifecycle, attribution or lead scoring to the product funnel

• Have worked across multiple countries with different pricing or packaging constraints

• Have experience in a regulated or healthcare context
