title: Lead Product Manager, DeFi
description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers. 

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do 

• Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.

• Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.

• Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.

• Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.

• Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are 

• 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.

• You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.

• Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.

• Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.

• Nice to haves: 

• hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch

• knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

title: Senior Performance Marketing Specialist

Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. description:
About the opportunity

As a Senior CRM Specialist (Engagement & Retention), you’ll own the customer journey from month two onwards. You’ll play a pivotal role in keeping our millions of users active, engaged, and thriving within the N26 ecosystem. This is a true 50/50 hybrid role: you will split your focus between driving high-level lifecycle strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute campaigns natively. You'll join our high-performing CRM team in Berlin to solve our most critical retention and reactivation puzzles.

In this role you will:

Operational Excellence (50%)

• Execute multi-channel CRM campaigns, employing a holistic approach to engage effectively with our customer base.

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure the seamless delivery of complex campaigns, leveraging your operational expertise.

• Champion adherence to established processes, both within your role and among stakeholders, to maximise campaign efficiency and operational excellence.

• Conceptualise, set up, and maintain automated communication workflows that support the achievement of CRM key performance indicators.

Analytic mastery

• Collaborate with data analytics and data engineers to ensure a data driven approach to your work.

• Utilise A/B testing methodologies to optimise campaign performance, leveraging your technical and analytic proficiency.

• Own and report on the development of your KPI’s.

Strategic Leadership (50%)

• Collaborate closely with the CRM team and seasoned CRM managers to conceptualise and plan new strategic campaigns that align with the company's overarching goals.

• Lead the implementation of these strategic initiatives, leveraging your strategic insights and operational expertise to drive success.

• Apply data-driven insights and your understanding of customer segments to ensure targeted messaging and the achievement of strategic objectives. 

What you'll need to be successful:

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

• 3+ years of experience in CRM roles

• Proven track record in CRM campaign execution and optimisation at a senior level.

• Strong technical skills, including HTML, SQL and A/B testing, to ensure operational excellence.

• Proficiency in CRM tools to drive effective campaigns. Braze experience is a strong plus.

• Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyse and interpret campaign performance data.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to lead cross-functional teams effectively.

• Creative problem-solving ability combined with a strategic mindset to drive innovation in CRM initiatives.

• Experience with reactivation programs is a strong plus.

What’s in it for you?

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. 

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members. 

• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service. 

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and backgrounds. 

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are 

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,700-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

title: Senior Product Manager - Operations Automation & Enablement (OAE)
description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Senior Product Manager - Ops Automation & Enablement (OAE) with a passion for building the intelligence and systems behind world-class banking operations.

This is a true builder’s role: you will lead the strategy, design, delivery, and enterprise-scale adoption of Agentic AI, hyperautomation, process mining, and internal tooling to reshape how complex, control-intensive Banking Operations are executed.

You will work cross-functionally with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders to ensure N26 can scale aggressively across markets and product offerings without proportional headcount growth—all while maintaining the strict regulatory and quality standards our customers expect.

In this role, you will:

Lead Enterprise Transformation & Agentic AI Adoption:

• Architect AI Workflows: Design, deploy, and govern E2E, multi-step Agentic AI solutions and automations that target high-volume processes, cross-team friction, and manual back-office tasks.

• AI Champion: Act as the primary AI Champion for Banking Operations: translating complex ML/AI concepts into practical, working systems rather than just talking about them.

• Change Management & Value Realization: Identify structural and behavioral barriers to adoption; design frameworks that embed new AI capabilities into day-to-day operations and team decision-making.

End-to-End Operating Model & Process Intelligence:

• Process Mining Re-Engineering: Lead structured process capture, process mining, and workflow mapping. Evaluate opportunities to completely redesign end-to-end workflows rather than merely automating existing inefficiencies.

• Core CRM & Platform Integration: Partner with Conversational Banking and Platform owners to optimize Salesforce (our core case-management backbone) and integrate AI agents with our central architecture and AWS infrastructure.

• Operational Efficiency & ROI: Define and track clear metrics for every initiative (FTE impact, handling times, error rates, cost-per-unit, and time saved) to ensure high business value and ROI.

Execution, Governance & Cross-Functional Alignment:

• Bridge Tech & Operations: Work directly with Banking Ops leads, Data Science, AI Enablement, and Engineering to turn operational pain points into clear product specs, PRDs, and prompt configurations.

• Regulatory Excellence: Collaborate with Data Protection, Legal, and Compliance teams to build resilient workflows that comply strictly with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and internal governance standards.

• Operational Readiness: Own product readiness for launches: ensuring changes in one pod do not disrupt downstream processes, control environments, or customer outcomes.

What you need to be successful:

• Product Management Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, Process Engineering, or Operational Transformation, ideally in a fast-moving tech, digital, or fintech environment.

• AI & Automation Track Record: Demonstrated experience taking ML, RPA, or Agentic AI products from 0 to 1 (or significantly scaling them) with measurable, quantified operational savings.

• Hands-On & Technical Curiosity: Comfortable working with APIs, prompt engineering, agentic frameworks, and orchestration tools. You are hands-on enough to build/configure the first version yourself, but strategic enough to design the long-term vision.

• Process Improvement Mindset: Proven expertise in workflow mapping, failure demand analysis, and structured waste-reduction methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).

• Regulated Environment Experience: Background in banking or fintech, navigating compliance, legal, and risk sign-offs in a control-heavy environment.

• Analytical & Data-Driven: Proficient in using data to model impact before building and measure results after (Power BI, SQL, or similar).

• Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of presenting complex trade-offs to senior leadership (EXCO/SteerCo) and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.

About You:

• Structured by default: You write things down, build systems, and actively retire processes that no longer serve the organization.

• AI-First Instinct: You inherently see how agents can augment human teams and make work faster, smarter, and cleaner.

• Pragmatic & Outcome-Focused: You care deeply about results, operational quality, and scalable growth, not just deploying shiny tools.

What’s in it for you:

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• Come together with your team in the office for a dedicated day of teamwork each week, plus another day of your choice, and enjoy the flexibility of remote work the rest of the time. Some roles may require additional in-office presence.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,700-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

• Hands-on experience with AI tools, including Claude, and at least one automation platform (n8n, Zapier, or Make)

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

title: Senior Country Commercial Manager - France
description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs

• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

• Over $300 million raised in funding

• 3,000 Tideans globally

• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

Please submit your CV in English.

About the team 

Tide is the leading business financial platform founded in the UK, empowering over 1 million small businesses to grow and succeed. Now expanding in France, Tide offers innovative financial tools and services to micro-entrepreneurs, freelancers, independent professionals (professions libérales) and small and medium-sized businesses (TPE/PME). Our mission is to save business owners time and money, enabling them to focus on what they do best - running their business.

You’ll be joining a dedicated and dynamic team in Paris focused on driving Tide’s market success in France. The Tide France team is in an exciting growth phase, bringing together professionals with deep expertise in fintech, product development and French market dynamics. As part of this expanding team, you’ll have the unique opportunity to shape Tide’s presence in France, working collaboratively to deliver innovative solutions for French small business owners. This is your chance to play a pivotal role in establishing the foundation for our long-term success in this key market.

About the role 

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Country Commercial Manager, based in Paris, to drive the growth of Tide’s business accounts and payment solutions in France. In this pivotal role, you will lead product growth initiatives, leveraging analytics, customer insights, and market trends to position Tide as a leading financial partner for small businesses in France.

As the Senior Country Commercial Manager, you will have accountability for French revenues, working closely with our Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams. Reporting directly to the Country Managing Director France, your expertise in the French market, SME customer behaviour and regulatory landscape (ACPR, PSD2, the e-invoicing reform) will be instrumental in shaping Tide’s offering and driving strategic growth.

Some of the things you’ll be doing:

• Revenue Ownership: Take ownership for driving revenue growth across product lines in France. Develop and execute strategies to meet revenue targets, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between product offerings, pricing, and go-to-market initiatives.

• Local Market Expertise: Collaborate with the product research teams to conduct French market research to uncover customer needs, analyse a competitive landscape of neobanks and traditional banks, and identify market opportunities, such as the e-invoicing mandate (facturation électronique) rolling out from September 2026. Translate these insights into actionable strategies to enhance Tide’s product offerings.

• Product Localization and Development: Collaborate with global product managers to design and launch products tailored to the French market, reflecting local payment habits, invoicing and accounting workflows. Lead initiatives to ensure local relevance and compliance with French and EU requirements, while maintaining alignment with Tide’s global vision.

• Marketing and Sales Strategy: Work with regional marketing teams to develop and refine marketing and sales strategies for marketing the products in the French market, including partnerships with key SME channels such as accountants (experts-comptables) and the entrepreneur ecosystem (Bpifrance, CCI, incubators). Monitor performance metrics and adapt plans to ensure we meet and exceed growth targets.

• Content and Collateral Creation: Support creation of high-quality marketing and customer-facing materials in French, ensuring they comply with French regulations (including ACPR rules on commercial practices) and resonate with local audiences.

• Operational Readiness and Go-Live Support: Partner with the Operations team to ensure seamless product launches, from final QA testing to internal training and ongoing support for new features.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the central point of contact between Tide’s global teams and the Paris team, driving alignment and ensuring projects are delivered efficiently.

What we are looking for 

• You have 7+ years' relevant experience ideally within the SME, SaaS, or fintech industries in France. Experience with banking or payment solutions for French SMEs is highly desirable.

• You are fluent in French (native or near-native) and professional English, as you’ll work daily with French customers and partners and with Tide’s global teams.

• You know the French SME ecosystem well (micro-entrepreneurs, TPE/PME, accountants, banking and payment players) and its regulatory environment.

• You excel at developing and executing commercial strategies that deliver measurable business impact. You’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves and remove blockers.

• You have very strong project management skills and can foster collaboration with teams outside of your direct control by building strong relationships.

• You’re well versed in product analytics, and can use data to drive decisions within product marketing campaigns and follow it up with actions to constantly improve on product acquisition and engagement goals.

• You’ve worked across multiple markets, navigating the complexities of global product development with a keen understanding of localization requirements.

• You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving company where priorities can change and processes may need to be created from scratch.

• You’re a self-starter who doesn’t wait for instruction, and who works backwards from targets to ensure effective execution.

What you’ll get in return: 

• 25 days of paid leave per year (congés payés)

• Additional 3 days of paid leave for volunteering or L&D

• We invest in your development with a professional L&D budget

• Complementary health insurance (mutuelle) and disability and life cover (prévoyance)

• Statutory pension contributions (basic and Agirc-Arrco complementary pension)

• 50% reimbursement of your public transport pass (e.g. Navigo)

• Extended Parental Leave

• Mental health support through Plumm

• A one-off home office budget

• Work and travel globally - up to 90 days per country outside of your home country

• Team socials 

• Sabbatical Leave 

Tidean Ways of Working

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices, including our Paris office, are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:

• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.

• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.

• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Stage Trade Marketing
description:
Job Location
Paris
Job Description
Au sein de l’équipe marketing opérationnelle instore de P&G France, tu seras le responsable marketing opérationnel pour tes marques. Cette responsabilité recouvre principalement la production de la PLV (supports de communication en magasin) fond de rayon et promotionnelle pour ces marques ainsi que la responsabilité des campagnes d’animations en magasin. L’objectif derrière est de convaincre nos consommateurs en magasin et d’augmenter nos ventes.
Pour cela, tu travailleras avec nos agences de créa pour la partie visuel/communication, nos agences de production pour le design et la production du matériel nécessaire ainsi que notre partenaire logistique pour la réception et l’envoi des PLV vers nos forces de vente.

Voici quelques exemples de missions que tu pourrais faire en tant que responsable de tes projets : 

• Orchestrer avec les équipes-marques (vente et marketing) et les agences la production de la PLV fond de rayon et promotionnelle (totem, arche par exemple visuel ici d’une arche pour le lancement de Fairy en février 21) pour un lancement d’innovation et suivre les étapes pour assurer une mise à disposition dans les temps pour notre force de vente
• Améliorer ou adapter un visuel créatif fourni par l’équipe marque pour l’utiliser sur un élément de PLV ou autre support destiné à être vu en magasin
• Collaboration avec la force de vente pour avoir leur retour d’expérience sur les PLV existantes et ainsi améliorer les modèles existants
• Faire le suivi budgétaire, suivi des bons de commande et des factures concernant un de tes projets en s’assurant que nous payons le bon montant pour la bonne qualité de service.

Ce que P&G te propose
• Responsabilités dès ton premier jour - des projets et responsabilités spécifiques te seront confiés et tu sentiras ton impact dès le début.
• Compétences reconnues en marketing de pointe - nous t’offrons la possibilité de tester tes connaissances en marketing et tes capacités de gestion dans des situations réelles et d'obtenir un aperçu du monde de la gestion de marque et d'entreprise.
• Mentorat continu - tu travailleras avec des personnes passionnées et recevras à la fois une formation formelle et du mentorat quotidien de la part de ton manager.
• Environnement de travail dynamique et solidaire - les employés sont au cœur, nous valorisons chaque individu et encourageons les initiatives, en promouvant l'agilité et l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée.

Date de début souhaitée: Janvier 2027

Job Qualifications

• Une sensibilité pour le marketing.

• Maîtrise du français (oral et écrit) et bonne maîtrise de la langue anglaise.

title: Omnichannel Marketing Manager
description:
Job Location
PRAGUE GENERAL OFFICE
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Omnichannel Marketing Manager who is ready to lead shopper marketing and omnichannel development for the drugstore channel. You will connect consumer and shopper plans with retailer priorities, strengthen brand visibility at the point of purchase, and build impactful partnerships with retail customers.
You will be responsible for the end-to-end planning, coordination, activation, and evaluation of integrated marketing campaigns across online and offline touchpoints. The role combines retailer partnership development, point-of-sale activation, e-commerce improvement, retail media, influencer support, and disciplined budget and ROI management.

In this role you will work on:
Retailer Partnerships and Omnichannel Development
• Build drugstore marketing partnerships and turn shared priorities into joint marketing and business plans.
• Develop the drugstore channel by connecting online and offline activity to improve brand visibility, shopper engagement, and conversion.
• Maintain the annual shopper and consumer marketing plan aligned with retailer needs and internal brand priorities.
• Lead retailer planning and performance meetings and update senior management on priorities, investment, results, risks, and next steps.

Marketing Planning and Campaign Execution
• Manage long-term and tactical campaigns across brands from cross-functional planning through execution, optimization, and evaluation, supporting other teams as needed.
• Coordinate in-store activation with chains, franchises, and partners including product placement, displays, promotions, brand events, and promotional calendars.
• Partner with retailer and internal media teams to coordinate the media mix, social, influencers, newsletters, CRM, loyalty, and local digital activity, including Meta Ads, Google Ads etc. 

Budget, Measurement and ROI
• Own marketing budget planning and control, including monthly investment reviews and balanced support across planned activities.
• Track campaign KPIs and analyze sales and marketing data to evaluate effectiveness and identify concrete next steps.

Stakeholder and Project Leadership
• Lead across functions partnering with Brand, Sales, Category, eCommerce, Media, Finance, agencies, and retailer teams.
• Lead agencies and project partners through clear briefs, strong execution standards, timely feedback, and performance evaluation.

Job Qualifications
Apply if you have:
• Relevant marketing experience ideally in customer or shopper marketing, trade marketing, channel development, FMCG, or drugstore retail.
• Strong understanding of 360-degree marketing and how online, offline, retailer, and media channels work together within an integrated campaign.
• End-to-end campaign management experience covering planning, coordination, execution, optimization, and performance evaluation.
• A strong track record of retailer relationship building and the ability to turn shared priorities into joint marketing plans.
• Knowledge of e-commerce, retail media, influencer activation, CRM, and loyalty marketing.
• Strong analytical and commercial skills including campaign evaluation, KPI management, budget control, and data-based decision making.
• Confident negotiation, stakeholder management, presentation, and project leadership skills.
• Ability to lead across functions and influence partners without relying on direct authority.
• Fluent Czech/Slovak and English.

Technical Skills
• Microsoft Office with strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
• Budget tracking, forecasting, campaign reporting, and performance evaluation tools.

What We Offer:
• Multicultural and international work environment.

As Influencer & Community Manager you’ll own end-to-end influencer partnerships, strategy and execution — from insight generation and talent selection to content delivery and performance optimisation — driving brand relevance, trust, and measurable impact across P&G’s portfolio. 
 
Alongside this, you will also ensure these creator-led moments continue to live beyond campaigns, contributing to ongoing conversation, advocacy, and community engagement across platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit. 
 
Working closely with Brand, Media, and PR teams, you’ll bring global strategies to life in a way that is locally relevant, culturally sharp, and built to perform. You’ll also help shape how we use cutting-edge tools and AI to unlock the next generation of brand building.

title: Senior Product Manager (Enterprise)
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.



Your main goal will be to empower n8n enterprise users to treat automation as software, enabling them to develop, deploy, and scale mission-critical workflows with absolute confidence.



To do so, you’ll own product strategy and execution for n8n’s Enterprise team, focused on application lifecycle management, developer tools, and production-grade workflow operations:




WORKFLOW LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT

 - Define how teams move workflows from development to production with clear environment separation and promotion paths.

 - Shape capabilities for workflow version history, rollback, branching, and conflict resolution.

 - Build product experiences that help engineering teams safely manage changes across mission-critical automations.
   
   


ENTERPRISE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE

 - Own Git-based source control workflows that make n8n fit naturally into modern software development practices.

 - Work closely with Engineering and Design to deliver powerful yet intuitive tools for technical teams.

 - Translate complex developer workflows into product experiences that feel reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt.
   
   


PRODUCTION OPERATIONS AND OBSERVABILITY

 - Build visibility into workflow performance, usage, and reliability across environments and instances.

 - Define how enterprise teams manage external secrets, variables, and configuration across deployments.

 - Help customers operate n8n at scale through multi-instance management and cross-instance visibility.
   
   


PRODUCT DISCOVERY AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

You'll own the methodology that drives successful Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements, accelerating customer adoption, getting high-value workflows into production, and enabling customers to become independent builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:


BUILD & LEAD THE DEPLOYMENT STRATEGIST TEAM

 - Hire, onboard, and coach a team of Deployment Strategists who partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver high-impact customer engagements.

 - Set a high bar for executive discovery, ROI definition, change management, and customer handovers, ensuring consistent delivery quality across the team.

 - Stay hands-on by leading customer engagements yourself while building the team, creating a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and customer impact.


OWN & SCALE THE DEPLOYMENT METHODOLOGY

 - Build and continuously improve our four-phase engagement methodology (Define, Identify, Co-build, Handover), including ROI frameworks, discovery guides, opportunity assessments, and handover templates.

 - Partner with CSMs, AEs, and Sales leadership to identify and qualify high-impact customer opportunities, define clear success criteria, and scope the right engagement model.

 - Turn learnings from workshops, hackathons, on-site builds, and staff augmentation engagements into repeatable playbooks that scale across FDE, Customer Success, and partner teams.


DRIVE CUSTOMER ADOPTION & BUSINESS OUTCOMES

 - Lead executive discovery and ROI conversations to align customer stakeholders on high-value automation opportunities, success metrics, and organizational change.

 - Measure engagement success through workflows deployed to production, customer adoption improvements, and measurable business outcomes, rather than services delivery alone.

 - Ensure seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers and provide CS and GTM leadership with visibility into engagement results, customer ROI, and expansion opportunities.


SCALE DELIVERY QUALITY & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

 - Partner with the Partner Delivery Manager and Partnerships teams to ensure external delivery partners follow the same engagement methodology and quality standards.

 - Help define readiness, certification, and quality expectations for partner Deployment Strategists to enable consistent customer experiences at scale.

 - Work closely with FDEs, Product, and Engineering to turn customer feedback, technical gaps, feature requests, and custom integration needs into actionable product insights.


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🤝 Enterprise Customer Experience: You have 7+ years of experience in customer-facing roles such as professional services, solutions consulting, implementation, or customer success within a software company.

 - 🌟 People Leadership: You have 2+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams, with a track record of building high-performing teams.

 - 🚀 0-to-1 Builder Experience: You've built or scaled a deployment, implementation, or professional services function and know how to create structure and repeatable processes in an evolving environment.

 - 💼 Executive Stakeholder Management: You're experienced in leading executive discovery, building compelling ROI cases, and securing buy-in from multiple stakeholders within enterprise organizations.

 - 🛠️ Technical Fluency: You're comfortable discussing workflow automation, integrations, and AI use cases with technical stakeholders and collaborating closely with engineers without needing to write code yourself.

 - 📊 Operational Excellence: You know how to define success metrics, build scalable methodologies, and turn customer engagement learnings into actionable playbooks.

 - 🎯 Customer Outcome Mindset: You're focused on driving measurable customer adoption and long-term value, rather than simply delivering projects or completing engagements.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - ⚡ Automation Platforms: You're familiar with n8n or other workflow automation, integration, or low-code platforms.

 - 🔄 Change Management: You have experience helping enterprise organizations drive adoption, navigate organizational change, and embed new technologies into their ways of working.

 - 🤝 Partner Ecosystems: You've worked with systems integrators, consulting firms, or external delivery partners to deliver customer implementations or technical engagements.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build a brand-new function at the heart of how we scale enterprise customer adoption. You won't just manage a team — you'll shape how we engage customers, demonstrate the value of automation, and turn high-impact use cases into production workflows that drive lasting business outcomes.

You'll work closely with leaders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering, with significant visibility and influence over our enterprise growth strategy. As one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, we offer the opportunity to build from the ground up, experiment with new approaches, and create a scalable deployment model that helps customers become independent, successful builders.

You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, collaboration, and continuous learning, where your impact will be visible from day one.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale. 

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two. 

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us. 

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Language Learning), Sparked (Education), Cosmic Jam (Physical Products) and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space. 

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.  

Turns out you can do both.

title: Product Manager
description:
ABOUT CODEWAY

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale. 

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two. 

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us. 

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Language Learning), Sparked (Education), Cosmic Jam (Physical Products) and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space. 

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.  

Turns out you can do both. 

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.




ABOUT THE ROLE


Most consumer AI lives on a screen. At Cosmic Jam, it starts with a device. We’re building connected products people use every day, each paired with an AI app and a membership. You’ll own one of those apps end to end. What it does in the first minute. Why people come back every day. What makes it worth paying for. And how we know it’s genuinely helping. You’ll work closely with engineering, design and Codeway’s infrastructure teams. This role is for builders who obsess over the first minute. Who read model outputs as closely as dashboards. Who ship, measure and improve, fast. We’ll share exactly what we’re building once we talk.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the app end to end, from the first minute of use to a daily habit.

 - Define what the AI does for people, and how its quality is measured and improved.

 - Shape how the app and the device work together as one product.

 - Connect the product to the tools people already use.

 - Build the membership and the premium features that make it worth paying for.

 - Track the numbers that prove it works, from daily use to retention and conversion.

 - Work closely with engineering, design and AI teams to ship continuously.

 - Own privacy and user trust, together with legal.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - You’ve shipped or worked on a conversational or agentic consumer product built on language models, and improved it from real usage.

 - You’re hands-on with the model layer: you write prompts and evals, read logs and prototype with AI tools.

 - You know what turns a first try into a daily habit.

 - You’ve shipped and grown a consumer subscription app.

 - You write clearly in English and thrive in a small team with little process.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with voice notes, meeting notes or dictation products.

 - Experience with task, reminder or calendar products.

 - Experience with wearables or other devices paired with an app.

 - Experience building integrations or connectors for AI assistants.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive Compensation. Because great work deserves great pay.

 - Full Private Health Insurance. Unlimited coverage.

 - Free Breakfast & Lunch. Every day at Codebrew, our in-office coffee shop, with barista coffee and healthy snacks all day long.

 - Meal & Transport Support. Monthly compensation that actually covers a proper lunch and your daily commute.

 - A Top-Notch Office. In the iconic Edifici Estel, right in the heart of Barcelona.

 - Flexible Schedule. We care about your impact, not about tracking your minutes.

 - Top Tech Setup. From a high-end laptop to the software and gadgets that help you thrive.

 - Wellbeing & Growth. Gym membership, English & Spanish course support, and a game corner for well-earned breaks.

 - Pet Adoption Support. We cover your new pet’s essential vet costs in the first year.

 - No Dress Code, Great People. A dynamic, talented, passionate team. Come as you are.



THE RECRUITING PROCESS

We are committed to keeping our recruitment process short and transparent. Here’s how it looks like:

 1. Application: Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. You can also just write a few words about yourself.

 2. Talent & Culture Interview: Let’s talk about your experience & expectations and see what we can achieve together.

 3. Technical Interview: You will meet with your future team lead to go over the case and your technical capabilities in detail.

 4. Case Study: We might send you a task to solve.

 5. Final Interview: A final interview with one of our senior leaders.

 6. Welcome Aboard! You are now a part of the team.

title: Senior Specialist, Product Insights
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Specialist, Product Insights

Overview
The payments ecosystem is rapidly evolving, driven by the growth of Payment Facilitators (PFs), Payment Service Providers (PSPs), Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Gateways, and other digital commerce enablers. These partners are reshaping how merchants accept payments and play a critical role in expanding acceptance and driving transaction growth.
The Channel Partnerships team develops innovative, data-driven products and AI-enabled capabilities that help ecosystem partners optimize performance, unlock growth opportunities, and deliver measurable business outcomes. This team sits at the intersection of product management, analytics, and commercialization to drive value for partners and Mastercard. 

Role

The Channel Partnerships team is seeking a Senior Specialist, Product Insights to support the development, commercialization, and growth of innovative products and capabilities across Mastercard's ecosystem partner landscape. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Analytics, Data Science, Technology, Commercialization, and Customer Success teams, helping translate data into actionable insights that inform product decisions, business growth, and ecosystem expansion.
The successful candidate will support the product lifecycle by conducting analysis, tracking KPI frameworks and product performance metrics, identifying market opportunities, and helping shape recommendations that enhance Mastercard's value proposition. The role will work closely with product managers and stakeholders to support initiatives across Payment Facilitators (PayFacs), Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Acquirers, and other ecosystem partners, while contributing to product commercialization, go-to-market activities, partner adoption strategies, and regional ecosystem growth initiatives.

Primary Responsibilities

• Support the development, commercialization, and growth of products and capabilities for PayFacs, ISVs, Acquirers, and other ecosystem partners. 
• Analyze market, customer, and performance data to identify opportunities, trends, and actionable recommendations. 
• Track KPIs, performance metrics, business targets, and ecosystem growth indicators to measure product adoption, partner value, and overall business impact. 
• Support product managers in evaluating opportunities, defining requirements, and advancing strategic initiatives. 
• Partner with Product, Technology, Analytics, and Data Science teams to deliver data-driven and AI-enabled capabilities. 
• Contribute to go-to-market activities, commercialization efforts, and partner adoption strategies. 
• Prepare insights, dashboards, and presentations to support decision-making and regional ecosystem growth.

All About You

• Experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, Analytics, Data Products, Financial Services, Payments, FinTech, Consulting, or related disciplines. 
• Strong ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights and strategic recommendations. 
• Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. 
• Ability to navigate ambiguity and manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment. 
• Proficiency in SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar analytics and visualization tools. 
Desired Capabilities
• Familiarity with AI tools, machine learning, data science, or intelligent product capabilities. 
• Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams. 
• Knowledge of the payments ecosystem, including PFs, PSPs, ISVs, Gateways, Acquirers, Merchants, and Digital Commerce solutions.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:
The PayPal Paid Media Center of Excellence is seeking an affiliates expert to scale this channel across our business units in the UK market. This individual will be solutions-oriented & self-motivated to drive channel growth. This role will ensure PayPal paid media best practices are in place across all campaigns in alignment with our global practices. 

This person will also be responsible for thought leadership pertaining to industry changes in the affiliates landscape, actively identifying solutions to evolve with them. This manager owns driving relationships with our affiliates agency & publisher partners in the UK. This individual will be accountable for driving connectivity back to the segment teams to ensure the affiliates programs ladder back to business priorities. This person will also be responsible for driving collaboration with cross-functional partners such as Analytics, Martech, ROI and Effectiveness & Marketing Ops to enable solutions to strengthen this channel.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities: 

• Develop and implement customer-focused, omnichannel campaigns to drive traffic, capture demand, and generate revenue

• Leverage data and technology to optimize marketing strategies and campaign performance

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align marketing initiatives with organizational goals

• Identify growth opportunities by analyzing and synthesizing data from multiple sources

• Track, measure, and report program performance, optimizing for efficiency and scalability

• Optimize team structure and processes to foster a culture of high performance and innovation

Minimum Qualifications:

• 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

• A minimum of 8+ years of experience in digital marketing, with a specific focus on affiliates marketing, in the UK market

• In-depth knowledge of the affiliates landscape

• Experience managing an affiliate program from the client side, preferably within a complex or highly regulated business

• Strong analytical and data-driven mindset to draw out actionable insights and make data-backed decisions

• Strong understanding of affiliate networks, tracking technology, attribution, publisher models, commission structures, and partner economics.

• Demonstrated success driving customer acquisition, revenue growth, and measurable business impact.

• Experience managing external agencies, affiliate networks, and strategic partners.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

• Experience with affiliate platforms such as Impact, CJ, Partnerize, or similar tools.

• Familiarity with digital measurement, incrementality, privacy requirements, and media attribution.

• 3+ years experience in working cross-functionally with Analytics/Martech teams

• Comfortable with communicating and pitching growth opportunities to segment and leadership teams

• Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communications skills

• Self-starter that can drive initiatives but knows when/how to escalate risks/blockers when necessary

• High proficiency in Excel/PowerPoint

• Excellence in stakeholder management, and the ability to juggle projects and business priorities across a variety of segments.

• Understanding of the financial services, financial tech, and payments industry / ecosystem a plus.

• Bachelor’s Degree required.

Subsidiary:
PayPal

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us. 

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

Job Summary:
The Head of Consumer, Germany is a senior leadership role responsible for deeply understanding the needs of German consumers, prioritizing those needs, and driving solutions with PayPal’s global product and engineering teams. The successful individual will own the consumer strategy, growth agenda, and market share expansion for PayPal in Germany — one of PayPal’s most important and competitive European markets. Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities: 

• Drive revenue growth and global market expansion by identifying and cultivating strategic partnerships, channels, and opportunities

• Lead the negotiation with external partners and engage cross-functional support colleagues to ensure the successful delivery of solutions for large complex partnerships

• Develop and execute an overall business strategy to identify and cultivate strategic partnerships, channels, and opportunities to drive revenue growth and global market expansion

• Influence the negotiation with external partners, engaging cross-functional support colleagues, to ensure successful delivery of solutions for large complex partnerships

• Align product and business levers (such as pricing and FX) to maximize revenue and market expansion opportunities

• Engage closely with product, engineering, and architecture teams to drive the architectural runway and determine the best technical implementation/design

• Represent the end customer on an ongoing basis and use this knowledge to drive effective prioritization and decision-making

Minimum Qualifications:

• 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Essential Responsibilities
Market Leadership & Growth
• Drive revenue growth and strengthen PayPal’s market position in Germany by identifying, developing, and scaling strategic consumer opportunities.
• Build and manage strategic partnerships, channels, and ecosystem relationships relevant to the German consumer financial services landscape.
• Lead negotiations with external partners and coordinate with cross-functional colleagues to deliver solutions for large, complex, and high-impact engagements.
• Align product and business levers (pricing, FX, incentive structures, value propositions) to maximize revenue and accelerate market-share expansion.
 
Product Strategy & Execution
• Represent the German consumer at all stages of product development, ensuring customer insights shape prioritization, design, and execution.
• Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and architecture teams to influence the architectural runway and guide optimal technical design choices.
• Drive the articulation and execution of a cohesive consumer strategy tailored to German market dynamics, regulatory requirements, and competitive pressures.
 
Strategic Leadership Responsibilities
Market & Consumer Insights
• Conduct deep analysis of user behavior, market trends, competitive signals, and partner insights to identify growth opportunities and inform strategic initiatives.
• Operate as the central coordinator for all consumer product activity in Germany — from insights and product performance to marketing and go-to-market execution.
 
Commercial Strategy
• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for PayPal’s consumer financial services product segment in partnership with global Consumer Financial Services teams.
• Define positioning, pricing, promotional strategy, and distribution approaches tailored to German consumer expectations and regulatory standards.
• Ensure adherence to German consumer-protection regulations, including vulnerable customer considerations, customer-outcome monitoring, and responsible product design.

• Oversee day-to-day commercial operations and ensure efficient processes to support growth and performance.
• Own the full P&L for consumer and product segments in Germany, including BNPL

• Analyze sales data, product performance, and market developments to drive strategic decisions and adjust priorities.
• Implement strong reporting systems to track commercial success and customer-outcome quality.

• Minimum 18 years of relevant experience with deep expertise in consumer financial services and/or digital consumer products. Working knowledge in BNPL would be advantageous.
• Proven track record of building, launching, and scaling high-impact consumer products in a global, matrixed organization — ideally within a regulated financial services context.

• Demonstrated success in driving commercial growth and scaling product segments across multiple functions.

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills; able to translate complex concepts into compelling, fact-based narratives.

title: Consumer Marketing Manager - Infant Feeding
description:
Job Title
Consumer Marketing Manager - Infant Feeding

Job Description
Your Challenge:
Translate consumer, market and business insights into compelling marketing plans that strengthen the Infant Feeding portfolio, build brand preference and support growth. Help bring new products to market and keep the existing portfolio relevant, shaping propositions that meet parents’ evolving needs. Bring global brand strategy to life through locally relevant campaigns and consistent consumer experiences, turning innovation and communication plans into meaningful connections with parents. Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, working across teams to build demand and improve marketing performance

Your role:

• Develop and deliver marketing plans for the Infant Feeding portfolio. Shape and manage an integrated global innovation and communication roadmap covering new product launches, commercial innovation, derivatives and the ongoing business.

• Translate global category strategy and roadmaps into locally relevant marketing activation across markets and channels. Adapt global content and develop local content where needed, reflecting consumer needs, market trends and media preferences.

• Work with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, R&D and Marketing Communications to develop compelling propositions and bring them to market on time and within budget. Guide initiatives through key innovation processes, balancing consumer needs with business goals.

• Use consumer, shopper, market and competitive insights to identify opportunities, shape plans and share relevant learning with global and local teams.

• Contribute to portfolio positioning, pricing and advertising and promotion plans. Partner with consumer and commercial analytics teams to track growth, market share and brand strength, using in-market results to refine plans and improve marketing effectiveness.

• Build your experience in portfolio marketing, go-to-market planning, consumer understanding and cross-functional collaboration while helping support families across their Infant Feeding journey.

You're the right fit if:

• Approximately 5 years of (international) working experience preferably within FMCG, consumer goods, consumer health or consumer electronics

• You have experience developing and delivering consumer marketing plans, including product launches, commercial innovation and ongoing portfolio activation.

• You can translate consumer, shopper, market, competitor and trend insights into relevant marketing strategies and practical actions.

• You have local or regional market experience, with an understanding of how to adapt global marketing plans and content for local consumers, channels and market conditions.

• You understand how to build a consistent consumer experience across touchpoints, in line with brand positioning and visual identity.

• You bring marketing and commercial acumen, and can contribute to portfolio, pricing, promotion and advertising and promotion plans.

• You’re comfortable using data and KPIs to monitor performance, identify gaps and recommend improvements to marketing plans.

• You can manage projects and stakeholders effectively, working across teams such as Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, R&D and Marketing Communications.

• You communicate clearly, take ownership and follow through, balancing consumer needs, brand consistency and business priorities.

Compensation & benefits
Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €61.185 - €101.976.

title: Senior Business Operations and Growth Lead
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Chief Business Officer organization drives company-wide growth and global expansion. 

This is the role that turns Airbnb's ambition for the UKI & Nordics into a plan and holds the organisation to delivering it: shaping strategy, aligning cross-functional teams, and driving sustainable commercial growth across one of our most important regions.

This includes recruiting and supporting high-quality Stays, Experiences, and Services, alongside executing Airbnb’s global market strategy. Shaping business approaches, quality supply sourcing, and international growth efforts are integral to the team’s success in connecting millions more hosts and guests to Airbnb's platform.

The Difference You Will Make

You will join the UKI, Nordics, Middle East and Africa team, covering one of Airbnb’s largest and most mature markets alongside five of Europe’s most digitally advanced, high-trust travel markets. The UK offers scale, brand strength, and a sophisticated regulatory environment; the Nordics offer strong domestic travel behaviour and significant headroom for growth. Together they make this one of the most commercially interesting regions in EMEA to build in.

A Typical Day

You will own the business operations agenda for the UKI and Nordics. Airbnb’s most established European market alongside five high-potential Nordic markets (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland). Partnering closely with the Country Manager, you will set the regional growth strategy, translate it into a plan cross-functional teams can execute against, and run the operating rhythm that keeps it on track. This is a high-visibility role: your influence will come from the quality of your thinking and your ability to mobilise teams to grow further.

Regional growth strategy

• Own the UKI & Nordics growth strategy end to end: define where the region should compete, what it should stop doing, and the handful of bets that will move guest nights, supply growth, and revenue.

• Build the annual and quarterly plan with the Country Manager, sizing opportunities and making explicit recommendations on where to deploy marketing spend, supply investment, and partnership effort.

• Set and pressure-test the region’s targets, translating global goals into market-level commitments that supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product teams can own.

• Run deep-dive analyses on demand and supply dynamics, competitive movements, pricing, and seasonality, turning each into a clear recommendation, not just a read-out.

• Identify and stand up new growth initiatives, using the UK as a test market for offerings that can then scale across EMEA, and the Nordics as a proving ground for high-penetration, low-friction market plays.

• Build the case for investment in the region: sizing, business case, and the socialisation needed to win resource in global planning cycles.

Operating rhythm and execution

• Own the region’s operating cadence: weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, so leadership has a single, trusted view of performance and the story behind it.

• Convert strategy into sequenced execution plans with named owners, milestones, and success measures across supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product.

• Track delivery against the plan, surfacing risks and bottlenecks early and driving them to resolution rather than escalating them.

• Design and continuously improve the operating processes the region runs on, raising the bar on efficiency, transparency, and decision speed.

• Lead the region’s input into global planning and resource allocation cycles.

Cross-functional leadership

• Act as the connective tissue between the UKI & Nordics team and global functions such as Product, Marketing, Communications, Policy, Finance, Data Science, Legal, and Community Support.

• Be the go-to decision partner alongside the Country Manager: the person other teams come to for the region’s position, context, and priorities.

• Build alignment on high-priority projects, market launches, and product tests, brokering trade-offs between global consistency and local market reality.

• Represent UKI & Nordics in NEMEA and global business operations forums, and bring the best of what other markets are doing back into the region.

• Partner with Public Policy on the regulatory landscape, including short-term let rules in the UKI and Nordic city regulation so commercial plans account for policy risk and opportunity.

Insights and storytelling

• Turn complex data into clear narratives that help leadership decide with a recommendation attached.

• Build the reporting layer the region relies on: dashboards, performance packs, and executive materials, working with a dedicated analyst.

• Establish the metrics that matter for the region and hold the team to a shared definition of success.

• Champion data-driven decision-making, and use AI tooling to compress the time from question to insight. Automating recurring analysis and reporting so the team spends its time on judgement, not assembly.

Your Expertise

To deliver in this role, Airbnb is seeking candidates with:

• 12+ years in business operations, strategy, consulting, or commercial leadership, with a track record of owning outcomes in a market or business unit

• Demonstrated ability to set strategy and drive it through to execution 

• Deep experience influencing without authority across a global matrixed organisation

• Strong analytical toolkit; comfortable working with finance and data science partners and interrogating the numbers yourself

• Exceptional written and verbal communication, with executive presence in front of senior leadership

• Comfort with ambiguity, and a strong bias toward action and ownership

• Practical fluency with AI tools and a view on where they change how a team operates

• Familiarity with the UKI and/or Nordic markets, or comparable mature-market experience

Additional

• Experience in a two-sided marketplace, travel/hospitality, or consumer tech

• Experience launching or scaling new products or lines of business in-market

• This role will require to be in the London office 3 days per week. 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

United Kingdom Annual Pay Range
£126,000—£158,000 GBP

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.
